cells.date: Bṛihaspati in Makara, in śuddha Pausha month.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the village of Piriya-Meḷapi to a certain Bāla-Sōmabhaṭāraka.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: States that a certain Saṅgapa constructed the temple of Mailāradēva.

cells.location: Pulamiti
cells.place: On a slab set up in the court-yard of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple
cells.date: Śaka 1458 (mistake for 1478), Rākshasa, Jyēshṭha, ba. di. 10.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Rāma[rā]ja.

cells.location: Puḷamiti †
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of Iśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. The date portion alone is legible.

cells.place: On a hero-stone set up near the entrance into the village of Sirivaram.
cells.date: Śaka 1246, Rudhirōdgāri, Chaitra, śu. di. daśami, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 771: Śaka 1246, Rudhirōdgāri, Chaitra, śu. daśami, Monday = A.D. 1323, March 18, Friday (not Monday); ·27.]
cells.remarks: Refers to the victory gained by the Mahāpradhāna Āḷiya Māchaya-Daṇṇāyaka over a certain Rāchaya-Nāyaka of Tumbeyakallu. Also records the death of a hero evidently on the same occasion.

cells.place: On two pieces of a broken hero-stone lying in the same place.
cells.date: Śaka 1243, Raudri, Bhādrapada, ba. di. 13, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 772: Śaka 1243, Raudri, Bhādrapada, ba. di. 13, Monday = A.D. 1320, September 1, Monday; ·52.]
cells.remarks: Records the death of the Mahāsāmantādhipati Hiriya Bomṇaya-nāyaka, son of Gaṅgēya-nāyaka of Hoḷalalu. In signature of the chiefs of [Ye]lamavu. The record further states that [Mohi]ya-Danṇāyaka, the prime-minister of the king, who is ruling the Penni-gaṇḍa granted wet and garden lands beneath the hero-stone, tank to those who were appointed to worship the hero-stone. Records the death of Maii-Nāyaka, son of Baṇadoya-Nāyaka, in a raid.

cells.place: On another hero-stone lying in the same place.
cells.date: Šaka 1238, Nala, Magha, ba. di. 6, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Mali-Nayaka, son of Banadeya-Nayaka.

cells.location: Kaṅchisamudram
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up in the court-yard of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple
cells.date: Šaka 1255, Śri-mukha, Āshādha, śu. di. 15, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 774: Śaka 1255, Śrīmukha, Āshādha, śu. di. 15, Monday = A.D 1333, June 28, Monday; ·35.]
cells.remarks: Statue that. Perumale, son of Gaṅgēja of Karīshasamudra, fought with the thieves in the battle-field in which kings had fallen" and without being robbed by died a hero.

cells.location: Kañchisamudram †
cells.place: On a boulder near the dilapidated Īsvara temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Relates to the grant of taxes for burning lamps during the Karthika festivals in the temple of Sōmēsvara-dēva at the Brāhmaṇa village of Kaṅchisamudra surnamed Pratāpanarāyanapura.

cells.place: On a stone pillar set up in front of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple at Madipalli, a hamlet of the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1624, Chitra-bhānu, Vaiśākha, śu. di. 1, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 776: Śaka 1624, Chitrabhānu, Vaisakha, śu. di. 1, Monday. = A.D. 1702 April, 17, Friday (not Monday). In Śaka 1623 (Vrisha) Vaisakha śu. 1, was Monday (= A.D. 1701, April 28) and in Tarana (= Śaka 1625) Vaisakha śu. 1, commenced at ·14 on Monday (= A.D. 1703 April 5). Probably the 2nd date is intended.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Relates to the construction of the temple of Hanumantadeva by Komti-guṇḍa for the merit of the Mahānāyakāchārya Sōbhācharya-Nāyuku.

cells.location: Dembēpāḷi
cells.place: On a stone pillar set up in front of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple at Madipi, a hamlet of the same village (as Īśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Registers that a talari of Dembēpāḷi was named after Narasiṃhanāyuḍu, son of Mangalāyi Vasanata-Nāyuḍu and accordingly received the major part of the talari's share.

cells.location: Demikēpalli †
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field to the east of the village of Nagana-palli, a hamlet of Chōla-samudram.
cells.date: Śaka 1418, Nala, Māgha, śu. di. Paurṇamē, Thursday, lunar eclipse. [date-calculation appendix, No. 778: Śaka 1418, Nala, Māgha, śu. Paurṇimā Thursday, Lunar eclipse. = A.D. 1497, January 18, Wednesday (not Thursday); ·72. Thursday is an error for Wednesday.]
cells.remarks: Registry the gift of the village of Tipapura for offerings to the temple of Chennākēśvaradēva at Chōlasamudra, by the Mahāpradhān Lipparasa-Vodeya of Penugonde.

cells.location: Chiḷumtturu
cells.place: On a slab built into the waste weir of the tank
cells.date: Šaka 1289, Plavaṅga, Prathamāshādha, śu. di. 14, Friday.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a kaḷamabōdha by Iroggappa-Odaya, son of the Mahāpradhāna Bayicheya-Daṇṇāyaka, while he was ruling at Chiḷumtturu.

cells.location: Chillumutturu †
cells.place: On a slab set up in the field near the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple at Sañjīvarāyanipaḷḷi, a hamlet of the same village (as Īśvara temple). †
cells.date: Šaka 1262, Vikrama, Bhādrapada, śu. di. 10, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 780: Śaka 1262, Vikrama, Bhādrapada, śu. di. 10, Saturday = A.D. 1340, September 2, Saturday. The tithi commenced at ·16 on Friday and ended at ·06 on Saturday.]
cells.remarks: Records the kodige grant of Valagaṅkāṇutakeabali by Visava-Danṇāyaka, son of the Mahāpradhāna Aliya Madchaya-Daṇṇāyaka, to gōpu-gāmuṇḍa, son of Chāvaka Bomma-Gauṇḍa.

cells.location: Chillumutturu †
cells.place: On a boulder to the west of the village of Chauṭakuntapalli.
cells.remarks: Records the grant on copper-plate of the village of Kañcha-karahalli for offerings and the lordly enjoyments of the goda Pāpanātha, Virūpāksha and Raṅganātha at Lēpākshi, by Ponuganda Virūpaṇṇa, son of Nan[d]i-Lakkī-Śeṭṭi.

cells.location: Chillumutturu †
cells.place: On a boulder below the tank bund at Bhīpasamudram, a hamlet of Hussenpuram.
cells.remarks: Records the Kodagi grant of a wet land by the learned mahājana of Bhūpasamudra surnamed Mōlāpura, to the d[e]vada of Guṇḍikā Bīvasa-Be[jj]i[d]ā, for his having executed some work in connection with the big tank of that village.

cells.location: Kōlāru
cells.place: On a stone set up in the courtyard of the Kōlāra Kēśavāsvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers that the part of the paddy grown under the tank of Kāḷikūru should be reserved for the repair of the tank.

cells.location: Koṇḍuru
cells.place: On a slab in the reserve forest
cells.date: Nandana, Vaiśakha, su. di. pañohami, Wednesday
cells.remarks: States that this tank and the channel, yard-wide, were constructed by Haḷaya, son of Mallayya of Naṇḍiḷikere.

cells.location: Chalivēndla
cells.place: On a rock in the Gani-Rangasvāmin hill
cells.remarks: Gives like the copper-plates a long eulogy in Sanskrit and registers the grant of Chalivēndla with its adjoining mountain and a number of other villages to the Śiva temple at Lēpākshi made at the instance of Vīrupanna. See below Part II, paragraph 74. A marginal note is added stating that the grant was made to a temple which calls Vīrupanna, the talavāra of the top of Vijayanagara.

cells.location: Chalivēndla †
cells.place: In the place of Kōlāra Kēśavāsvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers the royal order granting the village Cheluvindla surnamed Komara-Vēnkaṭadriyapura to Penugonde Vir[u]panna, the talavāra of Vidyanagara. Mentions the songester Lakha/jyana Hobaya.

cells.location: Chalivēndla †
cells.place: On a Nandī-pillar set up in a field to the east of the same village.
cells.remarks: The last face of the pillar is highly damaged. Mentions Cheluvindla.

cells.location: Chalivēndla †
cells.place: On a Nandī-pillar set up in a field to the east of the same village (as Kōlāra Kēśavāsvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of one fourth of the sobenahattu land as dasavanda under the tank of Balireḍḍihalli by Krishnarāya to a certain Ball-Reḍḍi, son of Chika Tata-Reḍḍi of Tōkaḷūru, for his having built a new village, temple, tank and wells there. The donee was expected to keep the tank in good repair. The characters are not so old as those of the time of Krishnarāya.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru
cells.place: On the pieces of a broken slab lying near the Ādiṇāyavasvāmin temple
cells.date: Śaka 1455, Vijaya, Mūrgaśira, ba. di. 3, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 789: Śaka 1455, Vijaya, Mārgaśira, ba. di. 15, Monday = A.D. 1533, December 15, Monday; ·86.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions the construction of a tank at Chēgēṭūru in Lēpākshi sthala in the Penugonda-rājya to the god Avubala of Chēgaḷūru, for the merit of the king.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Isvara temple in the same village (as Ādiṇāyavasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Refers to Mūḍu-muṇḍan chief whose name begins with Aluman and ends with Niḷamudha-Pāḷu-shāhi and to his minister. Also mentions Gōraṇṭla.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On a stone thrown across the supply-channel to the tank at Saṇagapalli, a hamlet of the same village (as Isvara temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1261, Pramadi, Srāvana, ba. di. 5, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 791: Śaka 1251, Pramādi, Śrāvaṇa, ba. di. 5, Monday = A.D. 1339, July 26, Monday; ·58.]
cells.remarks: States that the Jīyaru-Dēvasyāmi, son of the Mahā-prabhu of Chēgaḷūru-Hāsayya, while ruling at Penugonda, granted as sarvamānya, the village of Sōna-gavaḍanahalli to the goldsmith Sēḍaja-Pōṭoja, on his making a wristlet set with diamonds and rubies.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On a boulder by the side of the road from Buḍili to Gōraṇṭla.
cells.remarks: In archaie characters. Seems to record a grant of land for the maintenance of those who were asking (i.e., by begging). The exact meaning of 'kēḷdu bēḍuvavige' is not clear.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On a slab set up near a pond south of Buḍili.
cells.remarks: This is the will of Mādēvi, wife of Rayarasa. No one except those born in the family of Mādēvi could resume (?) the charity.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On a boulder under the tank bund to the south-east of the same village (as Isvara temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1469, Vijambi, Magha, śu. di. [2], Wednesday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 794: Śaka 1459, Vilambi (= Ś. 1460) Magha, śu. di. [2], Wednesday = A.D. 1539, January 22, Wednesday; ·13.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that a wet field had been granted for the worship and offerings of the god Kēśava at Būdali. Mentions Narasaṇanāyaka-Ayya. Also a field was granted for services to the god as before, for the merit of the king.

cells.place: On a boulder to the west of Reddicheruvupalli, a hamlet of the same village.
cells.remarks: Mentions Bhaṇḍāram Timma[ppa]-Koṇḍapaṁgāru and the gift of the village of Koṇḍāpuram.

cells.place: On a stone set up near a well to the north of Taunepalli, another hamlet of the same village.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Registers the koḍagi grant of the whole village of Madurekuṇṭeyahaḷḷi in Rāmaḍi-nāḍu to Māli-Reḍḍi, son of Bomi-Reḍḍi of Būdali, by the Mahāpradhāna Āḷiya Māchaya-Daṇṇāyaka.

cells.place: On a hero-stone set up to the north-east of Budidigaddapalli, still another hamlet of the same village.
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Mentions the hero (maganru) Dantiyamma who died piercing Ma[ṁ]gu-[Chō]ḷa. Dantiyamma is stated to have been the ruler of Pūdali, (i.e., the modern Būdili). Mentions also a Mutturāju. The record may be referred to about the end of the eighth century.

cells.location: Chēgaḷūru †
cells.place: On another hero-stone in the place of Isvara. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record the death of another hero called Ara[va]lla-Mahēndra Raṭṭaguḍi, a subordinate of Chōḷa-Mahārāja.

cells.location: Puleru
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field near the tank bund
cells.remarks: Records the gift of one kha of wet land at Śiṅgasamudram for providing one plate of food-offering, to the god Āḷḷāḷanāthadēva at Kañchi by a certain Avubaḷarāju, son of Narasiṁhyarāju.

cells.location: Kondapuram
cells.place: On a boulder near the deserted Chennakēśavasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: States that Daḷavāyi Krishṇappa-Nāyaka, son of Daḷavāyi Chennama-Nāyaka, the agent of the king, gave in gratitude for the fulfilment of his prayer that the king's accession to the throne of Vijayanagara must be a permanent one, the village Chernūru surnamed Chennakēśavapura for amṛitapaḍi and other festivities of the temple of Chennakēśavadēva in the Yeramañchi-bāgilu at Penugoṇḍe for the merit of the king.

cells.place: On a slab lying near the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1474, Paridhāvi, Pushya, ba. di. 30, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 801: Śaka 1474, Paridhāvi, Paushya, ba. di. 30, Saturday = A.D. 1553, January 14, Saturday. There was a solar eclipse on this day though not noted in the inscription.]
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of one iduṁ (two tūms) of wet land for the tirumāḷige of Kandāḷa Śrīraṅgāchārlu, by a certain Ka[lva] Tipparāju.

cells.place: On a broken slab set up near the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple at Gaunivaripalli, a hamlet of the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1449 (mistake for 1452), Vikṛiti, Jyēshṭha, śu. di. 5, Tuesday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 802: Śaka 1449, Vikriti, Jyeṣṭha, śu. di. 5, Tuesday. Vikriti corresponds to Śaka 1452 (not 1449). The details would give correctly A.D. 1530, May 31, Tuesday; ·46.]
cells.remarks: The grant is stated to be made for the merit of Ayyaparasayya.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin. †
cells.date: Śaka 1304, Sarvadhāri (wrong), Mārgaśira, śu. di. 7, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the grant of a village for the bodily and festive enjoyments of the god [Hire]-Anumantadēva. Mentions Kadiri.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the east of the same hamlet (as Chennakēśavasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged and broken. Mentions seventy-four subdivisions of the Pañchāla community and states that in the presence of Harihara-Mahārāya, the king, the people of the eighteen samayas—Haribha granted several privileges to the Pañchālas for their having made the throne in the pavilion (bajarāsanabāna).

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up by the side of the road to the west of the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Gaṅgarā Puligallu (?) and refers to the death of a hero.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On another hero-stone lying in the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Gaṅga-Trinētru* Ani-Bhinna Ari . . mēru fought with the Kurumas that lurked about Ayyapaśuseruvu (tank ?) and fell.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a rock near the Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple at Bayanaguntapalli, a hamlet of the same village (as Chennakēśavasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the grant of the village Adisēṭṭipalli and Bavanagōla included in the Malēla-sthala which together with Vōnavōlu formed the agrahāra called Kañjajayapura in [Pana]konda-rājya, by Appayya, son of [Nā]ga-Nāyaka, of the Mēla-kula, of the Kōśika-gōtra, Āśvalāyana-sūtra and the Ṛik-śākhā by the Mahānāyakāchārya Narasiṁha-Nāyudu, son of Nārapa-Nāyudu and grandson of Mallappa-Nāyudu of Kakalu for worship and offerings to the god Vēṅkaṭēśvara.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a stone lying in the bed of the Munro-tank at Kammavandlapalli, another hamlet of the same village.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the temple of Kēśavadēva at Oḍamūru by a certain Śigiri.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a stone lying in the bed of the Munro-tank at Kammavandlapalli, another hamlet of the same village (as Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple). †
cells.date: Šaka 1 [3] 27, Parthiva, Kārtika, ba. di. 10, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 809: Śaka 1[3]27, Pārthiva, Kārtika, ba. di. 10, Monday = A.D. 1405 November, 16, Monday; ·58.]
cells.remarks: States that Gaṅgā (sani), daughter of Bayiri-Seṭṭi of Yamidi and wife of Basavadēva-Nāyaka, son of Khayidēva-Nāyaka of Kāci, entered into the fire (i.e., performed sati) at Penugonda and that the king granted to her husband, Bappa-Nāyaka, set up the hero-hand in front of the Bandavāna (erected in her name) at Vānavōlu.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a stone lying in the channel to the north of the same village (as Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a rise-field to Baḍu-Vinaya of Raṅgasamudram by Koḍugaṇṭi Ṓbulaya.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field near Buḍḍigaḍḍapalli, a hamlet of the same village (as Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Registers the gift of a tank by Apinama-Gūgu Kommarāju of Vānavōlu.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a boulder near the tank at Jiṅgīravandlapalli, a deserted hamlet of the same village (as Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: States that Nagi-Seṭṭi, son of Tammi-Seṭṭi of Buḍḍah converted the Duṇḍabhala at Vānavōlu into a tank.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On another boulder in the place of Mādhavarāyasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to refer to the facts stated in No. 812 above.

cells.location: Kondapuram †
cells.place: On a boulder in a field near the tank of the same hamlet (as Mādhavarāyasvāmin temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1345, Śōbhakṛit, Kārtika, śu. di. 1, Friday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 814: Śaka 1345, Śōbhakrit Kārttika, śu. di. 1, Friday. In Śōbhakrit Kārttika, śu. 1, fell on Tuesday but in Śubhakrit preceding (= Śaka 1344) Kārttika, śu. 1, was Friday (= A.D. 1422, October 16, Friday) and it ended at ·83.]
cells.remarks: Mentions the vaiśya Śiṅgaya-Seṭṭi of the Tiru-Kaṇṭhanāthabikula and registers the construction of a tank by Tippi-Seṭṭi, grandson of Tammi-Seṭṭi Nagi-Seṭṭi, in memory of his father Nagi-Seṭṭi.

cells.location: Kammavaripalli
cells.place: On a boulder near the tank bund
cells.date: Śaka 1676, Yuva, Margéira, śu. di. 15, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 815: Śaka 1676, Yuva, Mārgaśira, śu. di. 15, Thursday = A.D. 1755, December 18, Thursday; ·66. Yuva corresponded to Śaka 1677 (not to 1676).]
cells.remarks: Registers a dasavanda grant of land to a certain Guruvappa by Bōhappa, son of Purushottamayya and grandson of Karṇam Vallabhayya of Chōḍura surnamed Kumma-varipalli and two reddis for having repaired the tank of the village called Eruchuru which was in ruins.

cells.location: Kammavaripalli †
cells.place: On a boulder by the side of the road from Gorantla to Gum-mayyagāripalli.
cells.remarks: Records that Vāraṇāsi Gaṅgārāju granted as charities the mango-grove, well, lamp-stands, lintels, water-sheds and avenues.

cells.location: Kammavaripalli †
cells.place: On a boulder in a field to the west of Gorantla.
cells.remarks: States that Timmapayya, son of Adappa-Nāyaka, granted as sarvamānya idanu-kuñchedu (two tumu and one kuñcha) of wet land to Chavadi-Reddi of Būtihi.

cells.location: Kammavaripalli †
cells.place: In a slab set up by the side of the road from Gorantla to Kasi-reddipalli.
cells.date: Śaka 1[37]3, Pramodúta, Bhadrapada,[ba]. di [3]0, Bunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 818: Śaka 1[37]3, Pramōdūta, Bhādrapada [ba.] di. [3]0 Sunday = A.D. 1450, September 6, Sunday; ·18.]
cells.remarks: Solemnly damaged Seema to record a privilege granted to the locrohabitants of the Ayyavale community.

cells.location: Kammavaripalli †
cells.place: On a slab set up by the side of the road to the north of Mereddi-palli, a hamlet of Mandala-palli.
cells.date: Śaka 1309, Prabbava, Magha, śu. di. 16, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Records that Pōli-Nāyuḍu, son of the Mahānayakāchārya Lakti-Nāyuḍu of Harigi, while ruling at Medireḍḍipalli, made a dasavanda grant of wet land to Pōla Bairāpōju and China Bairāpōju, sons of Dēvōju, for having dug a feeder-channel to the tank of that village from the river Chēru.

cells.location: Mallapalli
cells.place: On a slab set up in the court-yard of the Anjanēyasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of a wet land to the god, Hanumanta, at Mallapalli.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On a boulder below the tank bund
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to Naramayya by Yerama-Nāyuḍu.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the chávađi in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a field at Marulabande to the god Chennakésavadava for the merit of Apparasayya.

cells.place: On a boulder near the Áñjanéyasvámin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village of Vadigepalli as a sarvamánya-agrahára to Tirumala-Komára-Tátachárya, of Penugonda for the merit of his (i.e., the king's) mother, Veñgalaji-Ammaváru.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Chennakésavasvámin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a grant of money for conducting festivals in the temple of the gods Sómévara and Chennakévara at Vodigepalli.

cells.place: On the stone image of a king fixed into the platform in the central shrine of the Jagannātha temple in the fort at Athagodo (Kudala taluk, Ganjam district).
cells.remarks: Mr. Tarani Charan Rath, B.A., District Munsiff, Ongole, translates the record thus: "During the reign of Ananta Harichandana Jagadēva, the Raja of Aṭhagoḍo, this temple was constructed and the image of the god was installed on the pedestal by him, who is ever at His feet. He is the son of Rāmachandra Harichandana. His mother is Chandramadei. His brother is Bhramaravara Padmanābha sāmanta."

cells.place: On the right column of the inner entrance into the Tumbēśvara temple at Pratapur (Chatrapur taluk, same district).
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Tumbē[śvara-Mahādēva] by a certain Karma-Bhaṭṭa and his wife.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a stone lying at the outer entrance into the same temple.
cells.remarks: The grant portion is much damaged.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a stone lying at the outer entrance into Tumbesvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land and of 24 she-buffaloes, for lamps, to the temples of Ba[ṭe]śvara and Bīrēśvara.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the top beam of the outer entrance into the same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to register a gift of land made by the wife of a certain Nāyaka. Chinnaladēvi and Padmāvati are mentioned.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the top beam of the outer entrance into Valesvara temple. †
cells.date: sixth century A.D. †
cells.remarks: The letters are of about the sixth century A.D. The record is slightly damaged. Vide para 1, part II below.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of the Durgapañcha cave at Ramatirtham (Vizianagaram zamindari, Vizagapatam district).
cells.remarks: This is a fresh copy of No. 372 of 1905. The inscription is very much damaged. States that the saint (muni) Trikālayōgi Siddhāntadēva, the presiding teacher (āchārya) of the Dēśigaṇa and the spiritual teacher (guru) of king Vimalāditya paid respects to Rāmakoṇḍa (i.e. Rāmatīrtha hill), with great devotion. The king is given the titles Rāja-Mārtaṇḍa and Mummaḍi-Bhīma.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the pedestal of a broken Jaina image on the Gurubhaktakoṇḍa hill in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to state that the image was set up by Pra[mmi]-śe[ṭṭi] of Chanuda[vrō]lu in the Oṁggeru-mārgga.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the pedestal of a broken Jaina image on the Gurubhakta-konda hill in the same village (as Valesvara temple). †
cells.remarks: States that the shrine of Pārthīśvara was founded at Yindrakīla by Chaṭṭapa, through the favour of Vishṇuvardhana, son of Vikramāditya.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the front of the smaller shrine in the conserved Rāmānuja-maṭha on the same hill
cells.remarks: Much peeled off. At the beginning and end of the top line are seen the expressions Śrī-uand muni respectively, engraved in Chaḷukyan characters.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the front of the smaller shrine in the conserved Ramanuja-matha on the hill of Govinda. †
cells.remarks: The two letters Śrī and Sa, evidently the beginning of some name the rest of which is lost, are engraved here in Chaḷukyan characters to the size of about a foot in height. The formation and condition of the gorge suggest that there might have been some caves here.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On one of the pillars of the Akkhama-Madanna rock-cut cave in the hill of Ramanuja. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that two private individuals, one of whom was a potter of the village Pālūru in the Jammalamaḍugu-jillā, repaired the maṭha and resided in it.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the front wall and two other pillars of the cave of Ramanuja. †
cells.remarks: The names Śrīdharayya, Śrī-Utpāttipi[ḍuga], and Śrī-Guṇḍagōśāhi[tya] are engraved in Chaḷukyan characters.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a pillar lying in a street near the office of the Public Works Department in the same village (as Ramanuja-matha). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the supply of ghee evidently for lamps in the temple of Mallēśvara-Mahādēva by some reḍḍis.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a stone built into the Āñjanēya temple in the Brahman street in the same village (as Ramanuja-matha). †
cells.date: Śaka 1511, Virōdhi, Bhādrapada, śu. di. 11, Wednesday, Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇa-yōga. [date-calculation appendix, No. 839: Śaka 1511, Virōdhi, Bhādrapada śu. 11, Wednesday = A.D. 1589, September 10, Wednesday. The tithi ended at ·46.]
cells.remarks: States that Akshatala Tirumala-Bhaṭṭa of the Bhāradvāja-gōtra constructed a foot-path on the hill (kuruva) at Bejavāḍa for the favour of (god) Nārāyaṇa. The Sanskrit verse at the beginning states that salvation comes by a bath in the vicinity of (god) Nṛisiṁha to the west of Indrādri (i.e., Indrakīla hill).

cells.place: On a stone set up near the Agastyēśvara temple at Pedana (Bandar taluk, same district).
cells.remarks: Records the death of some unnamed person in the Hijra year 1028. His son calls himself Muhammad aga, the slave of the Prince of Saints ('Ali). In the beginning, God's blessings are invoked upon Imām Hasan the chosen, Imām Husain, the martyr of Karbala, Imām Ja'far the truthful, Imām 'Ali son of Mūsī Razī and the Imām of mankind, Muhammad at Mahdī-Hādī, the lord of this age and time.

cells.place: On a pillar in the Mukha-maṇḍapa of the Rājēśvarasvāmin temple at West Vipparru (Tanuku taluk, same district).
cells.date: Śaka 1221, Jyēshṭha śu. di. 1, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 841: Śaka 1221, Jyēshṭha, śu. 1, Saturday = A.D. 1299, May 2, Saturday. Śu. 1, ended at ·29 on this day.]
cells.remarks: Records that a certain [Du]dya Nāminēṇḍu gave the north-western pillar in the maṇḍapa of [the temple of] Narēndrēśvara-Mahādēva at Vipparru for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a second pillar in the place of Agastyēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the south-western pillar of the same maṇḍapa by a certain [Bikka]palli Sūrapanēṇḍu, for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a third pillar in the place of Agastyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the south-eastern pillar of the maṇḍapa by Gantamavōli Gaṅgana for the merit of his parents.

cells.place: On the same pillar ..
cells.remarks: Gift of the columns of the eastern entrance of the same maṇḍapa by Sāre [Kā]ṭaya-bhakta for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a fourth pillar in the place of Agastyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the north-eastern pillar by a certain Muttappa Ko[mma]na for the merit of his mother Bra[hma]sāni and his father Kāpinēṇḍu.

cells.place: On the white marble pillar set up in the Jaladhīśvarasvāmin temple at Ghantasala, (Divi taluk, same district.)
cells.language: Sanskrit in Telugu characters of about the 9th century A.D.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of dwellings made to 2,000 Brāhmaṇas of Ghaṇṭa[śāla] by the king.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the pillar of Jaina-śvetāmbara †
cells.remarks: Gift of 5 Kājaraja-māđas by a private individual for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Jaladhiśvara-Mahādēva at Ghantṣasala alias Chōda-Vāndyavura (i.e., Chōda-Pūndyapura).

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the pillar of Jaina-śvetāmbara †
cells.remarks: Gift of 10 rājakēsari-māḍas for two perpetual lamps in the shrine of Jaladhīśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla alias Choḷa-Vāṇḍyavura by Goṇḍa-sēṭṭi, the lord of Peṇugonda and a vaiśya of the Nabhōgōtra belonging to the Ghaṇṭaśāla-sēṭṭi and that of his parents Eyyama-sēṭṭi and Bammama.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the pillar of Jaina-śvetāmbara †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and mutilated. Seems to record a gift of money and lands to the temple of Jaladhīśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla. At the end is recorded a grant of 5 puṭṭis of land by a certain Puḷiyana-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the pillar of Jaina-śvetāmbara †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of a lamp to the god on the top structure of the temple of Jaladhīśvara. Records a pair of cloths to the god and goddess and that an image of Bhṛṅgi made on the roof of the maṇḍapa. The engraver of the record was Kunācārya.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the pillar of Jaina-śvetāmbara †
cells.date: Śaka 1142, Vikrama, Chaitra ba. di. 15, Sōmavāra, Viṣṇu-Saṅkrānti. [date-calculation appendix, No. 851: Śaka 1142, Vikrama, Chaitra, ba. 15, Thursday, Vishu-Saṅkrānti. In Vikrama Chaitra ba. 15 was Saturday. But in Vrisha following Chaitra ba. 15, was Thursday (= A.D. 1221, March 25).]
cells.remarks: Gift of 25 cows and a ball for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Jaladhīśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla by Kōmaṭi-śeṭṭi for the merit of his parents Mārasēṭṭi and Sūraṇi. Mentions the Susaṇḍhāraṇ and Sandhivigrahin Dēvaṇācārya.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the broken white marble pillar, lying in the Viśvēśvarasvāmin temple in the same village (as Jaina-śvetāmbara temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records the gift of a lamp to the god Bhōgēśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla by Nūṅkācārya, the architect of the temple. The Sanskrit verse praises the greatness of the king, the prosperity of the country Varaṇāreṇu and of Ghaṇṭaśāla.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift made to some deity at Ghantṣasala by Dāmi-Nayaka, a servant of the king.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the pillar of Viśvēśvarasvāmin †
cells.date: Śaka 1069, Kārtti-ka, su. di. 15, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 854: Śaka 1069, Kārttika, ba. di. 15, Monday = A.D. 1147, November 24, Monday, when amāvāsyā began at ·04 and ended at ·02 on the following day.]
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of 25 cows evidently for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Jaladhīśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla alias Choḷa-Vāṇḍyavura.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the pillar of Kāmalāṅga-valli †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of 5 cows evidently for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Jaladhīśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla alias Choḷa-Vāṇḍyavura by a lady.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a pillar in the Raṅganāthasvāmin temple in the same village (as Kāmalāṅga-valli temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the temple of Viśvēśvara-Mahādēva at Ghaṇṭaśāla alias Choḷa-Vāṇḍyavura.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a second pillar in Raṅganāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the mukha-maṇḍapa of the temple was built by Pallaśōlu Sarvvām, at the bidding of the god Raṅganātha in a dream, to perform this sacred service (kaṅkaryam).

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the south wall in the Yudhishthirêśvara temple at Mahandragiri (Mandasa state, Ganjam district).

cells.remarks: Gift of the brahman village Peru-Nilā alias Ranamugarāmachaturvēdimaṅgulam in Vembar-kuṇgram consisting of 26 shares at one share each to 24 Brahmans, one share for the Yajurvēda-vriṭti and 1 share for the Purana-vriṭti, by Sōlappillai alias Sambuvarayaṇ of Vēṭṭaikuṇi in Maladu alias Jananātha-valanadu on the southern bank, a district of Magadai-mandalam. The signature of Kulaśekhara Vilnupparaiyaṇ appears at the end of the record.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the west wall of the Periyanayaki Amman shrine in Vriddhāchalam temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of lands in a number of villages in Teṇkarai-śirvoai to Ruṅgappayyar brother of Ellamarasayya son of Bellem-koṇda Timmayyar for the midday off-rings of Periyammaī (goddess) by Sūrappavandāyar and the residents of Teṇkarai-śirmai.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the east wall of Periyanayaki Amman shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the tax talaiyārikkam in Kūgaiyūr-patti, for special worship on Fridays in the shrine of Periyanayaki in the temple of Poṇparappi-Nāyinār and Oppilāda-Amman in the temple of Pañchālakshara-Nāyinār at Kūgaiyūr by Adigam Krishṇappa-Nāyakar Ayyan for the merit of Sōrappa.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the western gōpura of Periyanayaki Amman shrine, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions a gift for the merit of Sōrappa-Nāyaka and timmay.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: In the place of Periyanayaki Amman †
cells.remarks: Gift of taxes levied in Kūgaiyūr, for the great worship (mahāpūja) and repairs in the temples of Poṇparappi-Chōḷēśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyinār and Dēvarāgal-tambuiranār Sakkathai. The Kūgaiyūr agent of Mallappa-Nāyakar, Achyutadēva-Mahārāya's adhyakshas is coupled with that of Krishṇadēva-Mahārāya as ruling in the same year.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the gōpura of Periyanayaki Amman, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Records an order of Nurayya-Nāyakar to the people of Magaṭai-maṇḍalam waiving the right of levying varuha-kāṇikke in the whole parru governed by him.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: In the place of Periyanayaki Amman †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the remission of certain taxes.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of Periyanayaki Amman shrine. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land for conducting worship in the two temples at Kūgaiyūr.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Pañchaksharadevara temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1468, Virodhikrit, Pañgupi 29, dasami, Saturday, and Pañgupi 28 ba. di. dasami, Mala, Saṭkramana.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Tiruppul-rōyal for repairs to the temple of Dēvan-Tiruppul-rōyal Pañchāksharam by Uratin Pāppa-Nayakkar agent of Vēṅkaṭappayya Vēṅgappayya agent of Sōrappa-Nayakkar.

cells.place: 113 On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1453, Vijaya, Kumbha, śu. di. Paarnami, Lunar eolipse, Mākha, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Mattuppal for the merit of the residents of the country of Tepparai in Maḍa-maṇḍalam to the temple of Pañchāksharam and Dēvaga-Tambirān on the occasion of the lunar eclipse.

cells.place: 114 On the east wall of the mandapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1468, Parābhava, Kumbha ba. di., amāvāsya, Sunday, Avāti.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Puduppalayam in Teṇkarai śīmai a sub-division of Maḍa-maṇḍalam for worship and offering to the shrine of Ilaiya-Nayinār in the temple of Dēvargal-Tambirān or Kūgaiyūr, by Vaḍamalai-Nayakkar son of Sōḍi Pāppa-Nayakkar agent of Sōrappa-Nayakkar.

cells.place: 115 On the south wall of the same mandapa?
cells.date: Śaka 1446, Tarana, lula, ba. di. ōkadaśi Monday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Gift of Urattūr as a dēvadana, free of taxes, for the great worship (muhāpūja) and repairs to the temple of Dēvargal-lambirāṇ Pañchaksharanādan in Kugaiyūr alias Tambiraṇköyil by Mpittyuñjaya-'ayakkar for the merit of Krishnadēva-Maharāya and Tirumalai-Nayakkar Ayyan.

cells.place: 116 On the same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1446, Tarana, Dhanus, śu. di. paurnai, Ārdrā, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Pullañgālan, on the southern bank of the Niva river, in Tepkarai Naraiyūr-kōṇram in Aragalār-śirmai a district of Malađu alias Jananātha-valanađu in Magadai-maṇdalam by the same donee who is stated to have been the agent of Tirumalai-Nayakkar.

cells.place: 117 Do
cells.date: Śaka 1446, Tarana, Dhanus, śu. di. prathama, Ārdrā, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the Kaikkōḷa servants and the dancing girls of the temples of Dēvargal Tambirān, and Pañchāksharam-raṇaral Kōgaiyūr by the donee mentioned in No. 116 above.

cells.place: 118 On the north wall of the same mandapa.
cells.date: Śaka 1426, Raktakshi, Vrīśchika, amāvāsya, Wednesday, Visakha.
cells.remarks: Gift of land, free of taxes, in Kōḍiyāmpaḍi by Eramuñchi Tuḷukkana-Nāyakkar to the temples of Dēvargal Tambirān and Pañchāksharam-raṇaral Kōgaiyūr.

cells.place: 119 On the gopura of the same temple
cells.date: Parābhava, Mīna, ba. di. saptamī, Mūla, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Seems to record a gift to the shrine of Ilaiya-Nayinār in the temple of Dēvargal Tambirān for worship, offerings, farming, in land in... by Vaḍamalai-Nayakkar agent of Sōrappa-Nayakkar Ayyan.

cells.place: 120 On a slab set up in front of the same temple.
cells.remarks: On the top of the slab 2 fish and a hook are engraved. Records that the temple of Nūyaṇār Bhagavadi-Ālyār is under the protection of Minavap Mukkōrkilanadigal.

cells.place: 121 On the south wall of the ruined Kailasanātha temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1506, Tarana, Vrīśchika, śu. di. paurnai, Saturday.
cells.remarks: Seems to refer to a gift of land.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the south wall of the Rajanā-rayaṇa-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Periyanayaki Amman shrine). †
cells.date: Śaka 1424, Baudri, Kārttigai, 7. [date-calculation appendix, No. 122: Three statues in the Varadarāja temple at Conjeeveram]
cells.remarks: Gift of money and land, free of taxes, to the temple of Rajanārayaṇa-Viṇṇagar-Perumāḷ at Perinagar-ayan-pāḍi alias Kōgaiyūr in Tuṇḍura-Nāṭṭu-kūrram in Magadai-maṇḍalam, for the merit of the king, in order that Bujabala Tammaṇar might rule the earth.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Rajanā-rayaṇa-Perumāḷ †
cells.date: Baudri, Tai 10 [date-calculation appendix, No. 123: An old water-supply project for Conjeeveram]
cells.remarks: Gift of land for worship in the same temple and for the festivals of the images of Rama, Raghava, Narayana and Krishna, taken in procession by Perangonai Tammaṇa-Nayakkar who repaired the maṇḍapa, set up the stone pillar and the pinnacle, built the surrounding wall and dug the tank.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the north wall of Rajanā-rayaṇa-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for the Madavilagam of Rajanārayaṇa-Viṇṇagar-Emperumān from the temple of Poṇparappiya-Chōḷēśvaramuḍaiyār.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the first gōpura of the Ranganātha temple at Tiruvaraṅgam (same taluk and district); right of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land for flower-garden for the merit of Rangappa-Nāyakkar. Śāḷuṭṭu-kūṭṭa-Nachchiyār-tiruttu appears as one of the boundaries.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: In the place of Ranganātha †
cells.date: Śaka 1480, Din-mati, Makara, Puṇarvasu, śu. di. trayōdaśī, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 126: Śaka 1480, Ḍurmati, Makarā, Punarvasu, śu. trayōdaśī Sunday = A.D. 1562, January 18, Sunday; ·37; ·89. Ḍurmati was Śaka 1483, (not 1480).]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that the vimāna was repaired and (the image of) Uttana-Raṅgan was probably reconsecrated by a certain Sīrāmaya.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: In the place of Ranganātha †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Gift of land in Eḷuttavaṇal for supplying the yajñōpavīta (sacred thread) to the god Ranganāthasvāmin.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: In the place of Ranganātha †
cells.date: Subhāṇ, Pañguni 29, Śaka 1505, Mina, śu. di. saptami, [Friday, Pūraṭṭadi].
cells.remarks: Mentions Embarmānar Ayyan agent of Puṇyamambi Ayyan agent of Eṭṭūr Kumāra Tattachāryar Ayyan of Uttara-Tiruvaraṅgam on the southern bank of Peṇṇai (Peṇṇār) and on the northern bank of Avinī in Korukkai-kūrram a subdivision of Mēykkāṇu-vaḷanāḍu in Magadai-maṇḍalam, the dēśāndiriyuṇḍa-Emperumānār-jīyar of Tirukkuravalūr.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the gōpura of Ranganātha, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Registers that Tiruvēṅgaḍayyar Ayyan of Aṇbāntr directed the lands given to the servants of the temple of Raṅganāthasvāmin at Uttara-Tiruvaraṅgam to be nirk-kuli-sarvamānya under orders of Eṭṭūr Tirumalai Kumāra Tāṭachāryar who bears the biruda, Vēdamārgga-pratiṣṭhāchāryar and 'Ubhaya-vēdāntāchāryar and who appears to have prepared the elephant vehicle for the god.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: In the place of Ranganātha †
cells.date: Śaka 1482, Baudri, Mēsha, ba. di. dvitiyā, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Damaged and lost.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Ranganātha †
cells.remarks: A Tamil verse composed by Kaliṅgarāya Uṇḍamulai Ellappan in praise of the god Vishnu. Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to a private individual for repairing the tank called Patalēśvaram.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the wall of Ranganātha †
cells.date: Śaka 1482, Siddhārthi, Mesha, śu. di. pañchamī, Śukravāra = Sunday. Śaka 1486, Dundubhi.
cells.remarks: A Tamil verse composed by Kaliṅgarāya Uṇḍamulai Ellappan in praise of the god Vishnu. Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to a private individual for repairing the tank called Patalēśvaram.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the east wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.king: Vīrapratāpa Śrīraṅgadeva-Mahārāya who having taken all countries was pleased to levy tribute from Ceylon.
cells.remarks: Gift of 25 halvajo of gold for half a lamp to the temple of Tiruvaiyāru-paramahādeva. The gold was deposited with the mahanagara (nagarattar) of Sivapuri.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Pañchanadīsvara temple at Tiruvaiyāru (Tanjore taluk and district).
cells.remarks: Built in at the end and the bottom. Gift of gold, for a lamp.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Ranganātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of 96 sheep for a lamp in the temple of Tiruvaiyāru-Mahadeva by Nakka Namban of Īyappaguram on the southern bank of the Pennai in Vanampādi. Built in at the end. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Tiruvaiyāru-Mahadeva.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the wall of Ranganātha †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of gold for a lamp. Mentions Malaināttu-chohaliya.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the west wall of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in-the-middle. Seems to register that the dancing girls were to enjoy the lands, given to them for service in the temple of Tiruvaiyāru-Udaiyār in Poygai-nāḍu a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaḷanādu, of which they had been dispossessed.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the north wall of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a transaction similar to that in No. 140 above.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the south base of the varanda of the second prākāra of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to carpenters' rights and pri-viliges in the temple:-Tiruvāppuḍaiyār, Aḷudaiya-Nāchchiyār, Ulagamādevi-Īśvaramuḍaiyār and Tribhu-vanamādevi-Tirunāmaḍaiyār.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of lamp.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the west base of the prākāra of Ranganātha. †
cells.king: Parakesarivarman alias Tribhuvanachakravarin Kulōttuṅga-Chōladēva Tri-bhuvanachakravarin Kōṅgimāikoṇ-dān.
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.place: On the west base of the prākāra of Ranganātha. †
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On another stone in the place of Ranganātha †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the historical introduction [Puvaras] etc. Appears to make provision for conducting the tirup-palli-eluchchi (rising from bed) service.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the north wall of the third prākāra of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land for feeding a Brāhmaṇa with sumptuous meal daily in the temple of Tiruvaiyāruḍaiyār by queen Ariñjigai, daughter of Ilāḍarāyar.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Ranganātha †
cells.dynasty: Chōḷa †
cells.remarks: Gift of the Brahman village Jñānasamudra-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Vikrama-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu to the Brahmans of the temple for various services and to a number of temples.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a stone built into the western gōpura of Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a chauri to the temple of Tiruvaiyāruḍaiyār by Pañchavan-Mādēviyār, queen of Mummuḍi-Chōḷa.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the east base of the Dakshina-Kailāsa shrine in Ranganātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Records in details the various ornaments given to the temple.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records that Vaṇavan Mārāyan of Vōvāśal set up the images of Pañchanadivāṇan and Añjalai-Umaiyār in Ayyāṟu.

cells.place: On the west of Dakshina-Kailāsa shrine †
cells.remarks: Gift of 20 kāśu for a lamp by Ammaṅgai-Nachchiyār alias Puvaṇamuḻududaiyāḷ of (?) Vaḍaśathamaṅgalam to the temple of Ten-Kayilāyam-uḍaiyār at Tiruvaiyāṟu in Poygai-nāḍu a subdivision of Tirupuvaṇamuḻududai-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Dakshina-Kailāsa †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of 20 kāśu for a lamp in the same temple.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the south base of the Uttara-Kailāsa shrine in Dakshina-Kailāsa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of seven bronze lamp-stands to the temple of Olōgamahādēvi-Īśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Tiruvaiyāṟu in Poygai-nāḍu a subdivision of Rājēndrasiṁha-vaḷanāḍu by Dantiśetti-Viṭaṅkiyār alias Olōgamādēviyār, queen of Rājarājadēva.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the bottom.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Gift of gold ornaments set with jewels to the same temple by the same queen as mentioned in No. 152 above.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the same base
cells.king: Rājarājadēva †
cells.date: 25th year †
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Contains a portion of the historical introduction of Rājarāja I. Records the gifts of various ornaments one of which is said to have been presented in the 25th year of Rājarājadēva.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Uttara-Kailāsa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the stone temple of Olōkamādēvi-Īśvaramuḍaiyār built by Dantiśetti-Viṭaṅkiyār alias Olōkamādēviyār, queen of Rājarājadēva at Tiruvaiyāṟu, a dēvadāna in Poygai-nāḍu, a subdivision of Rājēndrasiṁha-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the west base of the Dharmāmbika shrine in Uttara-Kailāsa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Gift of 10 vēli of land in addition to the existing dēvadāna which was found insufficient for conducting worship and offerings of the goddess Ulaguḍaiya-Nachchiyār of the Tirukkāmakkōṭṭam in Tiruvaiyāṟu in Ulagamuḻududai-vaḷanāḍu. Mentions Anapāyanallūr.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Brahmapurīśvara temple at Brahmadeśam (Villupuram taluk, South Arcot district).
cells.date: 41st year, and 284 days, Ṛishabha, ba. di. Tuesday, Anusham.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. The introduction commences with the words svasti śrī. Purchase of land in Panaiyūr, the southern hamlet of this village, in the name of Brahmādhirāya-Mahādēva by the assembly of the great men at Rājarājachaturvēdimangalam, a brahmādēya and a tani-yūr in this nāḍu, a subdivision of Gaṭṭikoṇḍa-śōḷa-vaḷanāḍu. It is stated that the king consecrated in the temple of Rājarāja-Viṇṇagar-Āḷvār which was his tutelary deity along with his subordinates (maganar) Adavallan alias Kulōttunga-śōḷamuṇḍavēḷāy who was governing the place, having consecrated the god (dēva-pratishṭhai), opened sources for water (jala-pratishṭhai), destroyed the weeds and supported the wise.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the north wall of Brahmapurīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the words svasti śrī etc. Gift of 128 cows for 4 perpetual lamps in the temple of Brahmīśvaram-Uḍaiyār at Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam by Aṇiyupuravan Mēṉmattan alias Kulōttunga-śōḷa-Mūvēndaraiyan residing at Tribhuvanamādēviyūr, the southern hamlet of Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam, a village unit by itself in the sub-division of Gaṭṭikoṇḍa-śōḷa-vaḷanāḍu in the province of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu. The donor also gave to the Piḍārai alias Rājēndra-śōḷa Nīlagangaraiyan, one of the ryots of Amūr in Uttamachōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On the wall of Brahmapurīśvara †
cells.date: 16th year, śu. di. trayōdaśī, Wednesday, Punarvasu. [date-calculation appendix, No. 160: Vikrama-Chōla. 15th year, śu. di. trayōdaśī, Punarvasu. The 15th year corresponds to A.D. 1132-33 and the month intended is Makara. On January 10, Wednesday A.D. 1134 (but this was in the 16th year), Punarvasu commenced at ·29; f.d.n. ·23. The tithi was trayōdaśī ·52.]
cells.remarks: Incomplete. The historical introduction begins with the words pū-mādu-puṇara. Records the same details as No. 159 above as far as the charitable disposition of the sub-division of the Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu is stated to be a sub-division of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu. Refers to Kaichāḷa-nāḍu Nāga-nāṭṭu Mūvēndavēḷān.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the wall of Brahmapurīśvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction commencing with the words pū-mādu-puṇara. Registers that certain brahmans of the temple of Pīśamūḍaiyāḍaiyār at Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam a brahmādēya and a village unit by itself in Panaiyūr-nāḍu a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu received 600 kāśu from the temple treasury and agreed to burn a perpetual lamp.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the wall of Brahmapurīśvara †
cells.date: śaka 134* VI, Tai 3, Kuṇḍha, ba. di. śu. di. (sic) Śivaṇam.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Registers that the Kaikkōḷa community in this territory were not allowed to use the high pillow (daḍu), and blow the conch. Aṇṇan-alavār-Nayiṉār having petitioned to a certain Kaṅgarayar they were allowed the use of the pillow and the conch on the analogy of other privileges of yogis in the provinces of Kañchi, Virūpākshapuram and Tiruvannāmalai.

cells.location: Athagoda, Kudala taluk, Ganjam district † — Odisha
cells.place: On a pillar in front of Brahmapurīśvara temple. †
cells.date: śaka 134* VI, Tai 3, Kuṇḍha, ba. di. śu. di. (sic) Śivaṇam.

cells.date: 5th year [date-calculation appendix, No. 179: Cholas—cont. Parakēsarivarman Rājēndradēva. 7th year, Mithuna, ba. di. 4, Thursday, Avittam. The day intended was apparently Thursday, 3rd June A.D. 1059, on which day nakshatra "Avittam" or "Sravistha" ended at 20 1/2 ghatikas after mean sunrise. But the tithi was ba. 5 and not ba. 4 and it ended at 27 1/2 ghatikas after mean sunrise. NOTE.—Ba. 4 probably an error for ba. 5.]
cells.remarks: The historical introduction commences with the words, pugaḻmādu (in Tamil script) etc. Registers that the dēvadāna lands belonging to the temple of Brahmīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva and the land given for feeding tapasvins in the Rājanārāyaṇaṉ-maḍam within the temple were clubbed together as a new village called Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷanallūr which was declared free of taxes.

cells.location: Vadigepalli
cells.place: On the wall of Brahmapurīśvara †
cells.date: 6th year, Vrischika, ba. di. 13, Tuesday, Svāti. In 1057 A.D. which fell in the 6th year of the reign, Tuesday 25th November (= Vrischika) was a day of "Svāti," which nakshatra began at 3 1/2 ghatikas after sunrise ending next day at 2 ghatikas after mean sunrise; but the tithi was the beginning of the 12th, not of the 13th in Bahula-paksha. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 180]
cells.remarks: Records the text of the uḷvari of the grant made in No. 179 above giving the detail description of the lands.

cells.location: Vadigepalli

cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction pugaḻmādu (in Tamil script) etc. Refers to the order of the king directing the transaction contained in No. 179 above.

cells.remarks: Built in at the bottom. The introduction begins with the words [Tamil script] etc. Seems to record a gift of land.
