Records an agreement by the trustees of the temple to Kānappa-seṭṭiyār, son of P . . . ṅgāṇdai-seṭṭiyār of the Vannikka-gōtra to provide certain sacred offerings to the god on particular occasions for an amount of 100 pon deposited by him in the temple treasury.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.remarks: Records the construction by an individual, probably a king, mentioned as "Naralōkavīra" of the kitchen rooms, a maṇḍapa and the prākāra walls, the setting up of a re-cumbent image of Hari and the further gifts of a gold pinnacle to this new shrine, ten perpetual lamps and a land for a flower-garden.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhātu, Pushya, bu. di., dvitīyā, Wednes-day.
cells.remarks: The introductory portion of the inscription mentions the king's conquests and the rest of the record registers a gift of five villages yielding an annual income of 1,500 varahas for sacred offerings, etc., to the god.

cells.place: On the north wall of the same 'rook'
cells.remarks: Records that the worshipful Kawalanandena Tatayya constructed all the necessary (vahanas) vehicles for the god, that he covered the Kaiyanakotī and Punyakotī vimanas with thick gold plates and that he dug a tank called Dēvarajārnava for the god's delight.

cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1434, Āṅgi-rasa, Mīna, śu. di., paurṇimā, Sunday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Gift of money for offerings on certain festival days.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of all the taxes accruing from all the villages, except fifty per cent, of the local devādāna lands in Salukkppāru in Veṅkaṭapuram-kōṭṭam to provide for the expenses amounting to 3,000 pon required for the services called Vīrakēraḷan-sandi and Nārāyaṇan-sandi alias Sundara-Pāṇḍya Kaḷingarāyaṉ-sandi for feeding 33 and 12 Brahmans respectively. Irāṇiyavēṭṭa-nāḍu in Paṇḍi-maṇḍalam are mentioned.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka, 1436, Bhava, Mithuna, śu. di., dasamī, Wednesday, Uttira-l'halguni.
cells.remarks: Gives in Sanskrit verse the genealogy of the king and records in Tamil that for the merit of his father Narasa-nāyaka-Uḍaiyār and his mother Nāgājīmman he had the Puṇyakoṭi-vimāna of the god gilt with pure gold.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1504, Chitrabhānu, Rishabha, śu. di., shashṭhī, Sunday, Makha.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the treasurers of the temple and the manager Eṭṭar Tirumalai Kumāra Tata-chārya-uyyaṇ to Tōppur Tirumalai-Nayaka, the dalavay (military commander) under Mahāmandalesvara Rāmaraju Veñkaṭapatidēva-Maharaja, to provide certain offerings and worship to the gods Pērarulajar, Ashtābhujatemberumaṇ, Soṇnavanamśeydaperumal, the goddesses Perundēviyar and Serakulavalli-nachohiyar and for certain Ālāvārs on certain festival days in return for 570 pon of gold which was the income derivable from the two villages, Ravuttanallar in Nagariyil-śirmai in Padaivdu-rājya, a subdivision of Jayaṅgonda-śolāmandalam alias Tondai-mandalam and Serukkupettuvār in Śeṅgalūnipaṭtu-śirmai in Chandragiri (-rājya).

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.remarks: The Sanskrit verse praises the king's munificence to poets and the Tamil verse describes his prowess.

cells.place: On the base of the east verandah round the 'rook.'
cells.date: Śaka 1453, Khara, Karkaṭaka, śu. di., dādamī, Friday, Mūla.
cells.remarks: The Sanskrit verse praises the king's munificence to poets and the Tamil verse describes his prowess. Records that Narasaṉyā of Sōlippākkam, son of Vīripa-kabu Daṇḍyaka of Puṭhūṭṭu assigned to the temple authorities the income of the village of Pallichchiruppakkam for conducting certain offerings to the god and also made provision for the supply of a portion of the prasāda to the son Chintāmaṇi.

cells.place: On the base of the south verandah round the same rook.
cells.date: Śaka 1470, Kilaka, Siñha, ba. di., pañchami, Wednesday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: End damaged. Records the gift, by purchase, of the village Kudulūr agrahāram by Sōrappa-nāyaka, son of Pōtu-nāyaka of Kasyapagōtra, for the Paḍavēṭṭai and the Toppurūṇai festivals.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: 8th year, Tula, ba. di., shashṭhi, Wednesday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Registers sale of one vēli of land for 200 paṇ. to Nāyanār Chakrapāṇinallūr, in Sevvūr-nāḍu, a district of Pāṇḍi-maṇḍalam, which was then presented by him to one Sāmānarāyaṇan for rearing a flower-garden for the god. The measuring rod naḍu-vilakkum-kōl is mentioned.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: Śaka 1466, Krodhi, Vrischika, ba. di., chaturdaśī, Thursday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of gold by Chennayyañgār, son of Timmay-yangār of Paljipadu, for certain repairs to a ruined tank called Pognamaraikkuļam and for offerings to the god to be made in the garden adjoining, on four festival days. The above charities are stated to have been made for the merit of Raja Rāmaraju Ayyan.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift, by purchase, by Madhusūdanan Apatsahāyan alias Rāmachandradēva, a resident of Sēravaṇmadēvi in Pāndi-mandalam, of the village of Kambantāngal alias Apatsahāyanallur in Sajukkipparyu, a subdivision of Anukkāvūr-nādu in Venkunra-kōṭtam which was a district of Jayañgonda-sōlamandalam, to a maṭha for rearing a flower-garden and supplying daily three garlands to the god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of money by Tiripirikkon Tayyāṇḍān alias Vijaya-nārāyaṇa, a maṇrāḍi of Tirunā-vaḷūr in Tirumana-nāḍu, a subdivision of Naḍuvin-maṇḍalam, for the daily supply of four tiru-tuḷa-garlands to the god.

cells.place: On the base of the south verandah round the same rook.
cells.remarks: Records the gift, free of taxes, of the village of Aheṭṭūr in Uttamallūr-paṟṟu, a subdivision of Iruṅgēla-nāḍu in Veṅkuṅga-kōṭṭam by Iḷaiyaḷvān Kaliṅgarāyan of Neṭṭūr, for offerings to the god every month on the asterism of Chitrā in which he was born and for worship, etc., to the images of Tiruvīthi-āḷvār consecrated by him.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: 5th year. Makara, 6u. di., trayodaśi, Monday, Mula.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions only the name of the donor, viz., Tiruppuliyūr-uḍaiyān Tamiḻ-āḷvān alias Sōḷiyadaraiyan of Mēlaikkoḍumālūr alias Uttamallūr-paṟṟu in Vaḍa-talai Sembiyan-nāḍu, a subdivision of Pāṇḍi-nāḍu.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: 1[4]th year, Aṇi, Monday, Tiruvōṇam = Monday, 5th June A.D. 999, which fell within the 14th year of the reign of Rājakēsarivarman Rājarāja I, as determined by Kielhorn. Reign commenced between 25th June and 25th July A.D. 985. (Ep. Ind. Vol. IX, page 217.) On this day nakshatra Śravaṇā or Tiruvōṇam ended about 38 ghaṭikas after mean sunrise. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 489]
cells.remarks: Records the gift as sarvamānya of the village of Tiṇḍurai in Amūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Puḷal-kōṭṭam by Madu-rāntaka Poṭṭappichōḷan Rājagaṇḍagōpāla for offerings and worship, to the god during the service called Ānai-kaṭṭiya Śaṅkaranāyaṉan-sandhi. Quotes the 8th year (presumably of Rājagaṇḍagōpāla).

cells.place: On the base of the south verandah round the same 'rook'.
cells.remarks: Bathination of the order contained in No. 489 above by the residents of Tirupuri.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: [1] 8th year, Makara, su. di., paurṇami, Wednesday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 32 cows and 1 bull by Jñānampēran Pillaiyāruḍaiya-Uḍaiyān, n dēśavallāļa of Vaigāvūr in Urukkāṭṭu-kōṭṭam for the supply of ghee for a perpetual lamp to the god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: 20th year, Mithuna, śu. di., saptami, Sunday, Śatabhi-sha).
cells.remarks: Records gift of cows by a private individual of Nēriyana-puram for a perpetual lamp to the god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift, by Īlaiyālvān Kalingaṇayar of Neṭtūr, of the taxes of the villages of Sirukōļi and Perunkōļi in Uttaramelūrparru for the expenses connected with the offerings to the god Nayaṇar Emberumaṇar consecrated by him, repairs to the temple, bhashyavritti for expounding the Ramanujabhashya and the feeding of certain jiyars in the temple maṭha.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records the gift, by Aḷaiyālvān-ayar of the village of Kūlōttunga-villagam in the eastern portion of Urukkāṭṭu-kōṭṭam, free of taxes, for offerings, daily worship, lamp, garland and other things required for the god Pugaliyūr-uḍaiya-nāyanār and the bhāshya and the feeding of certain Jīyars in the temple.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: Śaka 1475, Pramā-dōha, Riababha, ba. di., pañchamī, Aviṭṭam.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement by the temple trustees and the manager Ālagiyamanavalājiyar to provide certain offerings to the god on certain days from the income of Vallattaṇjeri Perjochchambakkam presented by Tiruvengālapar, son of Siruttiruma'laiyaṇgar of Talappakkam.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.date: Śaka 1474, Pāri-dhāpi, Makara, ba. di., pañchamī, Tuesday, Makha.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by the temple authorities to Periyatirumalaiyaṇgar, son of Annamaiyangar and Siruttirumalaiyaṇgar, son of Periyatirumalaiyaṇgar of Talappakkam for providing certain offerings to the god and for conducting certain festivals at specified scales of expenditure.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: One of the verses records the gift of the village Sardulapakam (Pulippakkam) in Toṇdai-mandalam by Kodandaraghava for expenses connected with the daily worship of the god. Another is a benedictory verse in praise of the god and the third praises the king's provess.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records the gift made by Śrimatu Kumāra Daṇayaka, of talayārimānya to the sattina Śri Vaishnavas of the temple, for the merit of Kāyasam Ayyapparaṣayyan and Narasayyan of Salaippakkam.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Gift of money for meeting the expenses on certain festival days. The grant was registered in the name of Pōrūru Nāyinār, son of Uruppūṭṭūr Tiruvengadayyan by Pēriya Tirumalaiyammaṇ Ṭaḷachāryar, agayent of Eṭṭūr Tirumalai Kumāra Tāḷachāryar Ayyag, manager of the temple.

cells.place: On the west verandah round the rock of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: 31st year, Kanya, tritiyā, śu. di., tritiyā, Vaishākha.

cells.remarks: Records gift of 32 cows and one bull by Girakkhi Perumānḍi-dēvar, sōn of Kamarasar, for a perpetual lamp to the god.

cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records the gift of 32 cows and 1 bull by one of the handmaids ([Tamil script]) of Gaṇḍagōpāladēva, for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of the same prākāra.
cells.date: 7th year, Kanyā, śu. di., daśamī, Wednesday, Mūla. [date-calculation appendix, No. 571: 7th year, Kanyā, śu. di., daśamī, Wednesday, Mūla = A.D. 1257, September 19; śu. 10 was current till ·92 and the nak. Śravaṇa (not Mūla as cited in the inscription) was current throughout the day.]
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Eriyagaram, a hamlet of Kūttanūr alias Rājādhirāja-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, by a native of the latter village for maintaining a flower-garden for supplying sacred garlands.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.date: Mithuna, śu. di., Shashṭhī, Wednesday, Uttara-Phalgunī.
cells.remarks: Seems to record that, while the king, seated with his consorts under the canopy called Ariyaṇṇavallāṉ on the throne of Vīravallāḷa in the Abhishēka-maṇḍapa, was listening to the songs of Śaḍagōpaṉ, he directed that a house for dwelling together with certain privileges may be given to a certain Kārambichchettu Narasiṅga-bhaṭṭaṉ who appears to have been an approved devotee of god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.date: Mithuna, śu. di., Shashṭhī, Wednesday, Uttara-Phalgunī.
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of all taxes levied on the village of Murukkambākkam belonging to the temple to a servant (name lost) of Sāḷuva Maṅgu-Mahārāju made on an occasion similar to the one mentioned in No. 572 above.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.date: Vikāri, Mēsha, śu. di., prathamā, Friday, Aśvatī.
cells.remarks: Records that the god invested the title of Brahmatantra-svatantra jīyaṉ on Vaishṇavadāsa and directed that a maṭha should be established for him with the lands necessary for its maintenance, that the books procured by him should be left with him and that towards the propagation of Rāmānuja-darśana by him and his disciples after him, all disciples of Rāmānuja and other devotees of the god should take him in their community. The occasion for the grant is the same as that mentioned in No. 572 above.

cells.place: On the north wall of the second prākāra, Arulala-Perumal temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1460, Viļambi, Vṛiśchika, ba. dī., pañchamī, Monday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Tirumukkūḍal in Śalipākkam-śīrmai in Kāḷattūr-kōṭṭam, a hamlet detached from Madurāntakam, for offerings by Śaḷakkara-Poṛiya Tirumalaiyā-ḍēvar, acting under orders of the feudatories of the king.

cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Records that the king directed that, out of 1200 pon assigned by him, in the year Vikpiti, for offerings to the temple, 150 pon should be transferred in the name of Govindayyangar, son of his preceptor Urupputtār Nallan Chakravarti Sirrayyangar, who was to receive ¼th of the offerings as such.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1462, Plava, Mēsha, śu. dī., paurṇamī, Sunday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Gift of 120 poṇ for offerings to the temple of Raghunātha in Vōgavati. The money was deposited on interest with Rāma-Bhaṭṭa, son of Bhaṭṭa-Bhaṭṭa, of Chiṭṭi-bhāṭin.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Stones missing and mutilated. Seems to record a gift similar to that contained in No. 572 above to a certain Vindukan.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1460, Viļambi, Kārttikai, śu. dī., dvitīyai, Jyēshṭha, Monday.
cells.remarks: Gift of 100 poṇ for celebrating the day of Śrījayanti festival on which Śrī Kṛishṇa was born. In making provision for worship and offerings, it was particularly mentioned that a lamp should be kept to be represented as a child drinking milk, placing the lamp in the shrine room. The gift was engraved on stone in the name of Vaḍa Tiruvengadaiyaṛ, the kōyil-kōvi, who was the disciple of Paravastu Ayyangār at the instance of Kaṇḍāśi Rāmānujayyangār, one of the managers of the temple.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1473, Virōdhi-kṛit, Māttam, śu. dī., dvitīyai, Śani, Revati.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings by Tiruppaḍirāja for the merit of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Sāḷuva Chinnayadēva-Mahārāja of his daughter Akkamā and of a garden for the merit of his daughter Akkamā.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1456, Jaya, Kumbha, ba. dī., chaturdaśī, Monday, Śravaṇa.
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Gift of the village of Uttiramaḷūi in Dāmal-kōṭṭam by Tiruvēṅgaḍa Appaṇ, son of Bhaṭṭadi-p[i]ran of Śrīvilliputtūr.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1472, Sādhāraṇa, Kumbha, dī., dvitīyai, Śatabhishaj, Uttarā-Bhadrapada.
cells.remarks: Beginning built in. Gift of the village of Śittapaṇi by Rāmabhaṭṭa, son of Bhāṭṭavāṭha Chiṭṭabhaṭṭa for offerings to the god Vūgavati Raghunāthan.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1458, Dur-mukhi, Kumbha, dvādaśī, Wednes-dha, Uttarāsha-ḍha.
cells.remarks: Records that Narayaṇa-seṭṭiyar son of Periyanāgu-seṭṭiyar of the Nedunkumāra-gotra, gave 530 gold coins to the god, the interest from which was ordered to be utilised for sacred offerings on certain festival days. Mentions also a temple and a maṭha dedicated to Tirukkachinambi, the Vaishṇava devotge.

cells.place: On the north wall of the second prākāra, Arulala-Perumal temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1455, Vijaya, Karkaṭaka, ba. di., tṛitīyā, Wednesday, Śatabhishaj.
cells.remarks: Records that the king soon after his coronation in the year Virōdhi directed that the gift of villages made to the temple of Varadarājadēva and Ekāmbaranātha should be of equal estimated worth and ordered Sāḷuva-Nāyaka to attend to it. But the latter gave more to Ekāmbaranātha than to Varadarāja and that, on hearing this, Achyuta went to Conjeeveram in person and effected the equalization between the two temples by casting lots.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.date: Rishabha, śu. di, duṣam1, Saturday, Hastu.
cells.remarks: Similar to No. 572 above. The recipient herein is Pottaraśaṉ, the minister (pradhāni) of Sāḷuva Maṅgu-mahārāja. In addition he was also given the right of levying taxes at 2 paṇam on storeyed houses and 1 paṇam on houses with inside verandahs.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1505, Subhānu, Tulā, ba. di, tritiya, Rohin1, Tuesday.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Chēdirāyaṉkuppam of Uraṭṭi-paṟṟu in Nallūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Veṅkuṉṟa-kōṭṭam in Paḍaiviḍu-rājyam for offerings and for conducting festivals by [Eṭṭūr] Tirumalai Kumāra Tātāchārya.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.date: Śaka 1510. Sarvadhari, Siṅha, śu. di., pañobum1, Satnrday, Chitra.
cells.remarks: Gift of the villages of Ālambākkam, Ānambāḍi in Kurumbarai-nāḍu, a sub-division of Kaḷattūr-kōṭṭam in Paḍaiviḍu-rājyam for offerings by the donor mentioned in No. 586 above. The gift was engraved in the name of Raṅgappayyaṅgār, son of Aṇṇavayyaṅgār, grandson of Paṭṭaṅgi Nayiṉār Ayyaṉ.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Arulala-Perumal †
cells.date: Śaka 1504, Chitrabhānu, Tulā, ba. di., pañchamī, Sunday, Mūla.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Teḷatteru in Iḍaivāśal-sīrmai for conducting certain festivals. The record was engraved in the name of the Āchārya of Tirumalai, Kumbakōṇam and Tiruma[rbar]pirunjōlai (Tirumāliruñjōlai), who had to meet the expenses out of the interest accruing on the money-income of the village.

cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the Anantalvār shrine in the prākāra of Arulala-Perumal. †
cells.remarks: Records that Śiyagaṅga of the Gaṅga dynasty built the Anantāḻvār shrine with stone. It mentions Chōḷēndrasiṁha as his father's name and gives him the birudas Kuvaḷāḷapuraparamēśvara, Gaṅga-kulōtbhava and Siraimīṭṭaperumāḷ.

cells.place: Inside the Karumāṇikkavarada shrine in the same prākāra.
cells.remarks: Records that the king set up in the temple the image of Vikramachōḷa-viṇṇagar-Āḻvār and for its daily worship made a gift of land, as dēvadāna, in the village of Vilvalam, which was renamed Akaḷaṅkanallūr, in Kaliyūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Kaliyūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.place: On the base of the south wall of Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1473, Virōdhikrit, Dhnuus, śu. di., ekadaś1, Tuesday, Aśvati.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Mōrpākkam near Āñjūr in Seṅgaḻunīrpaṭṭu-sīrmai which belonged to Daḷavāy Timmarāja, the agent of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Viṭhalarāja-Chinna Timmarāja-Pappu Timmayadēva-Mahārāja. The village was handed over to Daḷavāy Timmarāja on lease for providing offerings to Aruḷāḷa-Perumāḷ.

cells.place: On the base of the north wall of same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1471, Saumya, Karkaṭaka, śu. di., pañohami, Friday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: Records the assignment of the village of Iśāyūr, the income from which amounting to 120 paṇam was ordered to be utilised for sacred offerings, garlands and butter for the god by Dāyappa-nāyakar, the agent, of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja Tirumalarāyadēva, for the merit of his master.

cells.place: On the east wall of the Abhiṣēka-maṇḍapa in Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 30 cows and a bull for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Śri-Ramachandra-Perumaļ in Visira-nādu in Vaṇa-mṇdalam by the managers of the Arulaļa-Perumaļ temple at C.njeeveram.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle and a lamp-stand for a perpetual lamp by Nulappiyārūlāṇ Śarāyananambi Damōdaraṇ, one of the kēlvi-mudalis of Gāṇdagopaladēva.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Records the building of the maṇḍapa by Iḷamkōṭṭa-Nāyaṉār.

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by a native of Muraṇ-ottamaṅgalam in Valluva-nādu in Malai-mṇdalam.

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle and one lamp-stand for a perpetual lamp by Kandaṇ Eranambi residing in the city of Kulamūkku in Malai-mṇdalam.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle and a lamp-stand for a perpetual lamp by Iyakkaṇ Ayyanam'i, a native of Karāyappaļi in Malai-mṇdalam.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of 100 paṇam for offering cakes during certain festivals.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for offerings by a native of Kaḍavarāyaṉ-paṭṭu.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: Śaka 143 [1], Mēsha, ba. di., trayōdaśi, Tuesday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: Gift of 3,000 paṇam for offering cakes. The money was deposited with a native of Narasiṅgarāyapuram.

cells.place: On the south wall of Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning and incomplete. Mentions that King Sōmēśvara was descended from the family of the Moon and the Devika born of the Chāḷukya family was his chief queen.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: 3rd year, Kumbha, ba. di., tritiya, Saturday, Hasta. [date-calculation appendix, No. 603: 3rd year, Kumbha, ba. di., tṛitīyā, Saturday, Hasta. = A.D. 1294, February 13; ba. 3 commenced at ·79 and nak. Hasta at ·48.]
cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle and a lamp-stand for a perpetual lamp by a native of Iajarājapuram, a sub-division of Venkungra-koṭpam.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Enumerates the localities to which the (image of the) god may resort to after it was carried in procession on the elephant, horse and garuḍa vehicles respectively and after the car festival.

cells.place: On the south wall of Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.date: 21st year, Kumbha, 4u. di., ohaturdaśi, Tuesday, Makha.
cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp in the shrine of (Periyapraṭṭiyar), the senior consort of Arulaja-peruma] by a native of Tirumugaippadi-naḍu in Naduvil-mandalam.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Gift of four cows for one-eighth lamp by a native of Śarai in Vali-nāḍu.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Refers to an order of Mudartanka Poṭṭappichōḷan according to which taxes were levied on all oil merchants in Mummudichōḷapuram in Conjeeveram. The land mentioned as one of the places exempted from taxes in the order with the insignia of Ghaṭigōpāla were set up to mark the boundary.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.language: 5th year, Tula, 4u. di., prathamā, Monday, Viśakha.
cells.remarks: Gift of 97 cows and one bull for three perpetual lamps by Kōṇ Kaṭṭaiyan, a minister of Gaṇapaṭidēva.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.language: 5th year, Tula, 4u. di., prathamā, Monday, Viśakha.
cells.remarks: Refers to the order of Mudartanka Poṭṭappichōḷan. Records a grant similar to that contained in No. 607 above. The tax was levied here on merchants, Śāliya weavers and people residing in the streets of Arumoḷidēva-perumāḷ-teru, Rājarājapuram-teru, Nigarili-chōḷapperun-deru alias Gaṅgai-goṇḍa-chōḷapperunderu and Kuraivaniyap-perunderu.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Gift of cows and sheep for a perpetual lamp by a servant of Gaṇḍagōpāla.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by Mallaya Dandanayaka, son of Appaya Dandanayaka, brother (?) of the mahapradhani Dandinagopa.

cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by Kēśava Daṇḍa-nāyaka, son of the individual mentioned in No. 611 above.

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions a king with Śāḷuva birudas whose name is lost.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: Śaka 1464, Subhakrit, Mithuna, 4u. di., trayodaśi, Sunday, Mula.
cells.remarks: Gift of 250 puṇam for offering cakes on ekadaśi days after the return of the god from procession. The mousey was deposited on interest with the mangradis of Tiruvattiyūr.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: 24th year, Rishabha, ba. di., pañchami, Saturday, Uttara-Phalguni.
cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by Goppaya Dandanayaka, younger brother of Mallaya Dandanayaka, son of Appaya Dandanayaka.

cells.place: On the south wall of Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.date: 20th year, Siṁha, śu. di., daśami, Monday, Mūla.
cells.remarks: Gift of flower-garden by purchase by Muḍaiya Nāyaka for supplying flowers and garlands.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: 20th year, Siṁha, śu. di., daśami, Monday, Mūla. [date-calculation appendix, No. 617: 20th year, Simha, śu. di., daśamī, Monday, Mūla = A.D. 1237 August 3; ·16; ·79. The regnal year would, however, be not the 20th but the 22nd, a difference of two years.]
cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by mahāpradhāni Daṇḍinagōpa Madaya Daṇḍanāyaka.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †

The cows were left with Garuđanmel-alagiyar of the nambi caste and the possession of the land was given to Uttara-vedi-alagiyar for rearing a flower-garden.

cells.place: On the west wall of Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of 33 cattle for a perpetual lamp by a native of Nellore.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.date: 13th year, Mēsha, śu. 11, Thursday, Pushya, śu. di., Aṣṭami.
cells.remarks: Gift of 40 cows and one bull for a perpetual lamp and for offering milk to the god by Aruḷāḷan-appān Kōṇḍappuḷḷan alias Vikrama-Chōḷa Sāṇiyurāyan.

cells.location: Tirumallādi

cells.remarks: Gift of land in Kaliyūr for forming an agaram, to the Bhaṭṭas of the temple of Gaṇḍagōpāla-Viṇṇagar Emberumān at Kaliyūr in the 24th year of Rājādhirāja. Refers to the construction of the temple by the same individual.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Records the order of Madurāntaka Poṭṭappi-Chōḻan fixing the share of the produce which the occupiers of the area-nut and betel gardens belonging to the temple had to set apart and granting certain special privileges as to be enjoyed by the owners on the lands.

cells.place: On the east wall of the gōpura in front of the Abhisheka maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the introduction 'புகழ்மாது' etc.

cells.place: On the right wall of the gōpura of Karmmāśitkavarada. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction 'பூமன்னுபதும' etc. Gift of money for offerings at the early morning service by Vaṅgāḻattaraiyar-Udaiyān Mummuḍi-Chōḻan alias Anukkapallavaraiyan of Maṇi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Virudarājabhayankara-vaḷanāḍu, a district of Sōḻa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the left wall of the gōpura of Karmmāśitkavarada. †
cells.date: Saka 1450, Sarvadhāri, Mithuna, ba. di., pañchami, Sunday, Śatabhishaj.
cells.remarks: The record stops with the date.

cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: Records that Vasantayya, son of Ananta-Nāyaka and brother of Siṅga-Nāyaka made a gift of the four d:ara-pala images Chaṇḍa and Prachaṇḍa at the second and third gōpuras respectively and the two pinnacles of gold for the car.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Karmmāśitkavarada †
cells.remarks: The commencement of each line is very much damaged. Begins with the historical introduction 'புகழ்மாது' etc. Re-gisters the gift of money, free of taxes, by the people of Vaida-vūr in Urrukkāṭṭu-kōṭṭam, a sub-division of Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḻa-maṇḍalam, a district of Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḻa-maṇḍalam, to the Mahāmaṇji of Periyakōyil who was feeding the Brahmans versed in the sacred lore at Arikēśavan-maṭha situated on the north bank of the sacred tank (Tiruppoigai), of Aruḷ-aḷaperumāḷ.

cells.place: On the wall to the right of entrance into the Tāyār shrine in Karmmāśitkavarada shrine. †
cells.remarks: .... rday, Phālgaṇi.

cells.place: On the wall of Tāyār †
cells.remarks: Built in. Records the assignment of certain taxes from the village of Naḷḷāḷam in Vayalamur-paṟṟu A certain Gōpāladēva is the signatory. Remission of taxes, for the merit of the king, to Periya-pirāṭṭiyār, on certain lands in Paḍuṇāḍu alias Dēvī-perumāḷnūr in Kaliyūr-kōṭṭam which was given for flower-garden, by Śiddarasa.

cells.place: On the wall to the right of entrance into the Tayar shrine in Tāyār shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1415, Pramādicha, Mēsha, śu. di., Monday.
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records a gift of money by Narasādēviyār, wife of Kommarāja Periya Timmarāja Uḍaiyār for daily offerings to the god.

cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Tāyār shrine, to the right of entrance.
cells.date: Śaka 163 [2], Virōdhi, Phalguna, ba. di. 3o, Saturday, Uttara-Bhadrapada. Vrishabha lagua.
cells.remarks: Records that in compliance with the order of Śrīnivāsa alias Attān Tiruvēṅgaḍa Rāmānuja Jīyar, his pupil the chieftain Rāja Śrī Lāla Ṭōḍaramalla brought back the image of Varadarāja and his consorts from Uḍaiyārpāḷayam and set them up in the temple at Conjeeveram.

cells.place: On the wall to the left of entrance into Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: [6]th year, Vṛischika, śu. di., tritīyā, Monday, Anurādhā.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land, by purchase, in Dēvaperumāḷnallūr a paḍaippaṟṟu in Ūṟṟukkāṭṭu-kōṭṭam, by Tirukkāḷatti-Uḍaiyār, the headman (Kiḻavan) of Ambalvāymaṇalūr in Puḻal-nāḍu, a sub-division of Puḻal-kōṭṭam alias Vikramaśōḻa-vaḷanāḍu, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻamaṇḍalam, for the purpose of rearing a flower garden to the god.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.date: Śaka 1439, Īśvara, Mēsha, śu. di., ... Āślēsha.
cells.remarks: Built in. States that while Krishṇadēva-Mahārāya was camping at Kāñchī, he granted two villages for the floating festival of god Ēkāmbaranātha and that he constructed two small cars for the Vināyaka in that temple and for Krishṇa in the Perumāḷ temple and also specifies the routes which the Śiva and Vishṇu temple cars should take on the respective festival days.

cells.place: On the wall above the steps leading to Tayar shrine, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Registers that Tunai-irundān Nambi Koṅgarāyan assigned certain individuals as tirunandaviḷakkukuḍi to the temple and exempted them from taxes for burning two perpetual lamps in the shrines of Nāchchiyār Pērāruḷāḷar and Perundēviyār in the lamp stands presented to the temple by the king.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of gold for a perpetual lamp. Attippaṟṟu, a sub division of Paḍaivīḍu-rājya is mentioned.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.remarks: Records that Veṅkamma and Jānakī, the wives of the headman of Ālampaḷḷi, son of Veṅkaṭapati Tirumalarāo, paid a visit to the temple.

cells.place: In the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Built in. Records gift of 54 paṇam of gold for burning a twilight lamp to the god Varantarum-perumāḷ. The donee's name is obliterated.

cells.place: On the north wall of Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1452, ... Karkaṭaka, śu. di., tritīyā, Wednesday, Uttara-Phalgunī.
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning and incomplete. Registers an agreement by the temple trustees given to Kandāḍai Rāmānujayyaṅgār, the agent of the charities of the Rāmānuja-kūṭa-maṭham in the Sannadhi street, that for 2,600 chakram gold coins deposited in the temple treasury, certain specified festivals, processions and offerings to Pērāruḷāḷar and Mahālakshmī will be conducted. A supplemental charity of Narapparasayan, the agent of Rāyasam Ayyapparasayan for some other festivals and offerings is also mentioned.

cells.place: On the west wall of Tayar shrine. †
cells.remarks: in Same as No. 347 above.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1409, Plavaṅga, Mēsha, śu. di., saptamī, Sunday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Records that Vīrapāḷa-dāsyara, the son of Gaṅgādhara of the Āśvalāyana-sūtra and Vādhūla-gōtra, Narasiṅgarāya-Mahārāya, made a present of money for the reconsecration (?) ceremony of the images of Nachohiyār Pōraruḷār and Peraruḷāḷar in the temple and that he formed a new town called Vīrapāḷadāsayapuram and that having dug an irrigation canal in the temple lands and the lands granted to the god, and there being from the produce of these lands certain offerings were to be made to these images and that a fourth of these offerings should be given to the Rāmānujakūṭa-maṭham.

cells.place: On the south wall of Tayar shrine. †
cells.king: Kṛishṇarāya †
cells.remarks: States that Jāṭādhara repaired and regilt the Poṇyakōṭi-vimāna which was originally erected by Kṛishṇarāya and which had become dilapidated and that he also erected the Kalyāṇakōṭi-vimāna and had it also gilt with gold.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.date: Śaka 1536, Ānanda, Mesha, śu. di., 3, Saturday, Rohini, Kaṭaka lagna.
cells.remarks: Refers to the same events as No. 649 above, and gives the details of the date on which these consecrations took place.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Tayar shrine. †
cells.remarks: A set of twenty verses in praise of God Hanuman consecrated in the temple of Tātāchārya in the tank dug by and named after Tātāchārya. The verses re-engraved on the east and north walls of the rock, and also on the outermost gōpura, right of entrance.

cells.place: On the western base of the hundred-pillared maṇḍapa in the second prākāra of Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1491, ba. di., dvitīyā, Tuesday, Uttara-Phālguṇī.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land for certain festivals and offerings.

cells.place: On the west wall of the third prākāra, right of entrance, Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1477, Rakshasa, Siṁha, śu. di., dvitīyā, Sunday, Uttara-Phālguṇī.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, by purchase, in Āgaram Navēṇṭikū-laṭṭūr and Āgaram Dēvarāyamahārājapuram alias Poṇ-gaṇpākkam by Paraśāya Āḷagiyasingar, son of Muḍum-bai Appaḷi Annayaṅgār of Irumuḍi-aṅgārpuram and the Srīvatsa-gōtra, for cake offerings to the god on the birth-days of certain Āḷvārs and Āchāryapurushas and on certain other festival days.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.remarks: Built at the beginning. Gift of 3,500 kuli of land, houses and house sites, by Allumirhakalutēdēva Mahārāya-Gaṇḍapālava for the construction of the temple and its prākāra walls and for growing a flower-garden adjoining it.

cells.place: On the west wall of the third prākāra, right of entrance, Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1457, Manmatha, Mina, śu. di., saptami, Monday, Mrīgaśirsha.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement between the temple treasurers and the village assembly (ūrār) that Tiruppanipillai on the one hand and the temple on the other, should share the produce of the effect that as the areca, coconut and mango trees growing on these lands had withered on account of drought, fresh trees should be planted, the share in the produce which the tenant should reserve for himself being fixed on an improved basis.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar left of entrance.. †
cells.dynasty: Karṇāta †
cells.remarks: Records that Rāmāyā ordered the repair of the stone steps of the temple and called for some gifts to the Ekamranātha and Vandarāja temples. It gives the genealogy of the earlier members of the Karṇāta dynasty. The composer of the verses is one Obhala-dīkshita of Krishṇapuram.

cells.place: On the south wall of the third prākāra, opposite the Udaiyāyar sannidhi, Tayar shrine. †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land in Kuvalaivedu by Rayasam Timmakkan for certain festivals and for singing the Tiruppallandu-hymns of Periyaļvar, which function was being conducted by Kandadai Anavaiyangar.

cells.place: On the wall of a dilapidated maṇḍapa next to the Magayāyar sannidhi.
cells.date: Śaka 1389, Sarvajit, Siṁha, ba. di., obaturūdi, Wednesday, Āvaṇi.
cells.remarks: Records that two pieces of land, which belonged to the temple in padaipparru alina Te-ramal mallai and which remained uncultivated on account of non-irrigable high level were purchased as Ulavakkāpi by the treas-ury of Tirumolijīyār, reclaimed and brought under cultivation and that these lands were leased out for 200 paṇam of gold per year by the temple.

cells.place: On the left wall of the stable-maṇḍapa.
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhātu, Kumbha, śu. di., dvādaśī, Wednesday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land, by purchase for 170 panams of gold, for offerings to the god on particular festival days by Vengayar Kaļastinātha of Paramēsvaramaṅgalam, the tiruppani-vāšal kanakku in the temple.

cells.place: On the right wall of Tayar shrine. †
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhātu, Kumbha, śu. di., pañchamī, Wednesday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by purchase for 50 paṇam of gold by Nallār, Periya Eṛappan Chinnaiya of the Aṅgaṇḍai for cake-offerings to the god on five particular Je-cval days in different months.

cells.place: On the wall of the outermost gōpura, right of entrance
cells.date: Śaka 1325, Chitrabhānu, Kumbha, ba. di., saptami, Wednesday, Anuradha.
cells.remarks: End much damaged. Records the gift, by Ōbaladēva-Mahārāja, of 32 cows and a bull for maintaining a perpetual lamp in the temple. A large number of high-sounding titles mentioned to Pruluvār Podukkam Auba-dēva-Mahārāja, who appears to be the father of the donor of the gift.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar †
cells.date: Śaka 12[96], Ānanda, Kārttikai, śu. di., ohaturuda-śī, Wednesday, Śatabhishaj.
cells.remarks: Records the naṭṭu-maṇi, free of taxes, of Uttamachōlanallūr alias Kolipakkam, a village in Brahmadēśap-purru in Virpūdu-nāḍu, in the sub-division of Kaliyūr kōṭṭam, by Kōnappa, son of Muddappa for worship and daily offerings to the god. Aruṇābagadan and Bāshākuṭṭappa-rāyara-gaḍay are mentioned as birudas of Muddappa.

cells.place: On the wall of the outermost gōpura, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Contains two laudatory verses in praise of one Rāmānuja-jīya of Tiruppalāni, who is stated to have undertaken some extensive repairs to the temple at Conjeeveram and to have attained to great fame and beatitude.

cells.place: On the wall of Tayar, right of entrance †
cells.king: Krishṇarāya †
cells.remarks: Records that King Krishṇarāya endowed the Paṇyakōṭi-vimāna of the god with gold plate.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: Do. left of entrance
cells.remarks: In modern characters.

cells.place: On the east base of the gōpura of Tayar, left of entrance. †
cells.date: Śaka 1408, Vyaya, Tuḷa, śu. di. dvādaśī, Friday, Puśya.
cells.remarks: Records that Rāja-Rāja and Chōḷapperumāḷ, the agents of Tirumalai-Nāyaka made, on the occasion of ‘Saṅkrānti-puṇyakāla, arrangements with certain individuals in of Dāsi and tennōri of the Vayilakkāvarpāvu for burning lamps before the god.

cells.place: On the same base, right of entrance
cells.date: Śaka 1408, Parabhava, Sirnha, śu. di., tritiya, Friday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement by Ayiyamman and Iyyampēṛṛu to burn a lamp before the god for the merit of the king.

cells.place: On the west base of the gōpura of Tayar, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Records the employment of certain individuals in Paḍai-vīḍu, under the charge of Karavāyur as tiruvilakku-kuḍi, granted by Ēgappa-nāyaka Tirumalai-nāyaka for lamps to the god.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Tyāgarāja shrine, Tiyāgarājavāṉin temple, Tiruvārūr, Negapatam taluk, Tanjore district.
cells.remarks: Begins with the short introduction ‘Svasti śrī’ etc. Gives the details of the quantity of gold which was used for plating and gilding the different parts of a golden pavilion (ponmēynda-tirumaṇḍapa) etc.

cells.place: On the south wall of Tyāgarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records the completion with the king’s own ‘Vēṅka-ḍan Tiruntinakaṇṭhan alias Adhikāri Irumuḍi-śōḷa-vāḍavēḷān utilised certain gold and silver vessels in the temple treasury for the erection of a golden pavilion for the God Uḍaiyār Viḍiviṅkadēva of Tiruvārūr in Tiru-vārūr-kōrram, a sub-division of Adhirājarāja-vaḷanāḍu. The four verses engraved in continuation refer to several gifts of golden ornaments by Kaṭṭan Sambiyan Veṇḍavēḷān of Pūṅgūr.

cells.place: On the wall of Tyāgarāja †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction ‘Pūmādu puṇara’ etc. Records gift of 3 kalañju, 1 mañjāḍi and 1 kuṉṉi of gold of standard weight and fineness and equal to Rājarājan māḍai by Arumoḷi-rājēndra-chōḷan, which was invested by the temple assembly in purchasing and leasing out 450 kuḷi of tax-free land for the expenses connected with the sacred bath of the god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the wall of Tyāgarāja †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction ‘Pūmādu puṇara’ etc. Built up the gift of 96 sheep for a perpetual lamp to the temple of Mūlasthānam-uḍaiyār of Tiruvārūr, in Tiruvarūr-kūṛṛam, a sub-division of Gēya-māṇikka-vaḷanāḍu by one Nārāyaṇa Siṅgaḷattaraiyan, a portion of whose full name is obliterated.

cells.place: On the south and west walls of Tyāgarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction “Բցոր Կժուղք,” etc. Records gift of paddy for offerings and worahip during certain festivals and of b kasn of gold for the purchase of pieces of cloth required to cover the pots of water for the god's bath.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Tyāgarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Registers an order of the king to the managers of the temple of Mulasthānam-Udaiyār of Tiruvārūr in Tiruvārūr-kūrram, a sub-division of Kṣatriyaśikhāmaṇi-vaḷanādu making some provision for different festivals and for offerings on special festival occasions. Mentions the Sādayam of Ārpasi and Ārdrā of Ādi as the asterisms of the king's father and the king respectively.

cells.place: On the west wall of Tyāgarāja shrine †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Begins with the introduction "திருமகள் போல" etc. Records an order of the king to Vēḷāla-kuṭṭan alias Sembiyan Mūvendavēḷan to cover with gold plate certain portions of the garbhagriha and ardha-maṇḍapa of the temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of Tyāgarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "திருமகள் போல" etc. Records the gift of a wreath of precious stones for the goddess, consort of Udaiyār Vidiviṭaṅkadevar by Paṇmakkalūruḍaiyān Vāḷan Seyyapādam of Gaṅgaikoṇḍaśōlapuram.

cells.place: On the wall of Tyāgarāja †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "திருமகள் போல" etc. Records that Kuṭṭan alias Sembiyan Mūvendavēḷan of Ārpāḍi, a vaḷanādu, made tax-free gift of land by purchase for 100 kaśu for offerings to the god and that his brother Māran alias Sembiyan Mūvendavēḷan made another tax-free gift of land by purchase for 100 kaśu from the assembly of Puḷivālam, a brahmadeya of Vijayarājēndra-vaḷanādu for the expenses of feeding daily 12 śivayōgins at the temple and making two gold ornaments for the god.

cells.location: Tirumallādi
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction “Բցոր Կժուղք,” etc. Records deposit of gold by Purakkedayan Surri Ādittan alias Solavichchadira Vilupparaiyan of Purakkuđi in Ambar-nādu a sub-division of Uyyakonda-valanādu with certain merchants of Tiruvār for providing offerings and oil for bath to the god and further gifts of gold for supplying clothes to the images and fees to temple songsters and servants.

cells.place: On the north and west walls of Tyāgarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "திருமகள் போல" etc. Records the details of the quantities of paddy accruing from the several bits of temple devadāna lands in the villages of Tyākuḍi and Mānnamaṅgalam which were bought over by the king and Aṇukkaiyar Nakkaṇ Pavai-naṅgaiyār for expenses connected with offerings and worship to the god Tiruvārūruḍaiyār.

cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the introduction "Suyandamai-ete.". Given a detailed list of the gifts of Rajendra-Chola-deva and his servant (?) Anukkiyar Parainangaiyar for plating and gilding certain portions of the temple, of Arumolittan alias Lokanarayana, of pearls and coral wreaths and several other gifts of precious stones and ornaments and lamps to the god. Rajarajan-kalan-niyayam is mentioned as the standard weight of gold.

cells.place: On the west wall of the Valmikanatha-the-shrine, same temple.
cells.remarks: Sundaramurty Nambiyar, one of the priests at Tiruvanaikkovil and Valmikanatha who were in the custody of one individual were now left in the joint charge of two men Brahmanarayar and Viluppadarayar and haye down what ought to be done when any discrepancies arise in the jewel accounts if the seals of the ponnaydarasal were mis-handled.

cells.place: On a slab lying in the Gopuram-jamin temple at Bollavaram, hamlet of Proddaturu, Cuddapah district.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of [olls in the palli as at Bollavaram in Gaddaluru-nādu which he held as a nayankara, by the Mahamandaleśvara Timmaraju of the Ātreya-gōtra and horn of the Lonar race, for offerings to the temple of Gōpīkanātha-Perumal on the day of Kōmāți-sari.

cells.place: On a slab in a field on the northern side of Modimadugu-palli, another hamlet of Proddatūru.
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhātu, Āshādha, śu. di., 13, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the Garuda-pillar was set up by Vaiyayya, son of Komdi-Seți.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xvi||273" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XVI, No. 273</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: Hattibalagallu
cells.place: On a stone set up by the side of the road to Aluru in the same village (as Gōpuram-amin temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Registers the grant of the village of Hatiyabelagallu to the Jiya of that village for cooking and worship, by Mahāmandalēsvara Śri-Ra[m]

cells.place: On another stone set up by the side of the road to Aluru in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1432, Pramōdūta, Magha, ba. di., 2, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Jakke-Nayaka and the village of Hatiyabelagallu. Seems to record a market-regulation.

cells.location: Nemmakallu
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Vrishabhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of 10 pada of gold levied on the members of the Vīra-Śaiva community in the village of Nemmikallu, Ramapuram, Sumigalapuram, Beju[du]ru, Timmapuram and Nala-Timmapuram by Ajati Vira-Śaiva Siddha-Bhikshāvriti-Ayyavāru for a perpetual lamp the temple of Virabhadra at Nemmikallu. It is stated to have been granted at the request of...

cells.location: Beludona
cells.place: On a stone lying near the Basavanna well
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land as tax-free to five persons for having repaired and restored the well named Madi-gondana-bhavi, by Kachi Rahuta-Lingappa-Nayaka, the pārapatya of Chippagiri-siime and agent of the Maha-mandaleśvara Aliya-Raghunatharajadava-Maha-arasu.

cells.location: Kundalagurti
cells.place: On a stone set up near the Āñjanēya temple
cells.remarks: Registers the gift of the village Kundalaguppa surnamed Dēvalāpura to Gurumūrti Liṅgaṉārādhya-Oḍeru by Mahārājādhirāja Haṇḍeya Dēvappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Chippagiri
cells.place: On a slab in the Kēśavasvāmin temple
cells.date: Śaka 1430, Vibhava, Vaiśākha, śu. di., 15, Saturday.
cells.remarks: Registers the construction of a tank and the grant of lands under it, for offerings and festivals in the temple of Prasanna Kēśava-Perumāḷ at Chippagiri and for the maintenance of the Brahmans serving in the temple, by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Timmayyadēva-Mahārāja, son of Kandanavōli Rāmayyadēva-Mahārāja and grandson of Āraviṭi Bukkayyadēva-Mahārāja. Chippagiri was situated in Mūdanāṇṭi-sīma which was held as a nāyaṅkara by the donor.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the Bhōgēśvara temple in the same village (as Kēśavasvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: Much worn out. Seems to register a grant of land to the temple by a certain Chika Timmappaya to certain Brāhmaṇas doing service in the temple. Ādavāni is mentioned. Another grant dated in Ānanda which is also damaged is given at the end of the record. This refers to Tirumalayyadēva Mahā-arasu.

cells.place: On a stone lying in Bhōgēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: In archaic letters. Gift of 50 mattar of land for a flower-garden. Bhavatharma Bhaṭārka Nerahōja is mentioned.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the Timmappa (Vēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ) temple in the same village (as Bhōgēśvara temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1450, Sarvadhāri, Vaiśākha, ba. di., 30, Monday, Solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of land for offerings etc., to the temple of Prasanna-Veṅkaṭādri at Chippagiri in Mūdanāḍu-sīme belonging to Arakereya-venthe.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the Suṅkalamma temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1474, Paridhāvi, Pushya, ba. di., 30, Solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of rice for offerings, to the temple of Suṅkadakaṭṭe Vināyakadēva at Chippigiri by Nāgappa the seṭṭi of Timmarasadēva, the officer in charge of the tolls (suṅka) of Ādavāni-sīme and the agent (kāryakarta) of the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Koṇḍarājadēva-Mahāarasu.

cells.location: Nancherla
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up near the Rāmaliṅgasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the death of Mamma-maṅka-gāmuṇḍa in a cattle-raid.

cells.location: Rāmadurga
cells.place: On a slab lying in the courtyard of the Bhīmēśvara temple
cells.date: 8th year, Ānanda, Āshāḍha, śu., Amāvāse, Monday, Vyatīpāta-Saṅkrānti, Solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of lands, garden, a house-site and an oil mill for conducting offerings, festivals, repairs, etc. in the temple of Bhīmēśvara situated on the banks of the Tuṅgabhadrā in Sindavāḍi Thousand by the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Vīra-Iruṅgōḷa-Chōḷa-Mahārāja who has a long praśasti. The temple was founded by a certain Bōvi-seṭṭi.

cells.place: On a slab lying near the Bhōgēśvara temple in the same village (as Bhīmēśvara temple). †
cells.date: 6th year, Dundubhi, Magha, punname, Monday, Lunar eclipse, Uttarā-yaṇa-Saṅkramaṇe.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village of Honanaĵi for offerings, etc., in the temple of Svayambhu-Bhōgēsvaradēva at Indavali in Sinupavāja situated in Ādavani 600, by the Daṇdaṇayaka Chiyamarasa who was the hergaĉe of Sindavađi 1000, under the orders of his father, the heriĵlasandhivigrahin Kēśimayya who was ruling Manedeĉenadu, Miriti-naĉa Kolipaka-naĉu, Sindavađi-naĉu and Kallakejagu-naĉu.

cells.place: On another slab in the place of Bhōgēśvara... †
cells.date: Chajukya Vikrama 4th year, Siddharthi, pushya, Amavasye, Thursday, Uttarayana-Sahkranti.
cells.remarks: Kanarese

cells.place: On a third slab set up in the place of Bhōgēśvara. †
cells.date: Chajukya Vikrama 4th year, Siddharthi, pushya, Amavasye, Thursday, Uttarayana-Sahkranti.
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Records the remission of taxes sesse, siddhāya etc. on 12 mandalis including Indravoli by Ballaha.

cells.place: On a slab lying near the Hanumana-dōpa in the same village.
cells.date: 8th year, Ānanda, Jyṣeṭha, śu. tadige, Friday.
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Records the remission of taxes sesse, siddhāya etc. on 12 mandalis including Indravoli by Ballaha.

cells.location: Haalaharivi
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Hanumana-dōpa in the same village (as Bhōgēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Do. Registers the grant of land in the village of Ājēgera for a feeding-house for the itinerant Brahmans and Śūdras who resorted to the temple of Chennakēśava at Halaharivi. The grant was made at the request of Aliya Rāmappa.

cells.place: On a pillar lying in the place of Bhōgēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Kanarese

cells.location: Kaminahālu
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Maramma temple
cells.dynasty: Ajare-Khāne Khōda Yivamda Amadali Ayana-Śana-malki jam Akarama-mulki Abdula Baba Sa.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of land free of taxes to a gavuda of Kāvinahalu which belonged to Adavāni [distriot].

cells.location: Virupapura
cells.place: On a pillar in the Lakshmi temple
cells.date: Śaka 143[0], Sukla, Śravaṇa, śu. di., 10, Thurs-day.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of land free of taxes to a gavuda of Kāvinahalu which belonged to Adavāni [distriot].

cells.location: Virupapura
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Timma-ppa temple
cells.date: Śaka 143[0], Sukla, Śravaṇa, śu. di., 10, Thurs-day.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of one kasn per hēru (builock-paok) on the hērus that come into the market at Virupapura, for the temple of Tiruvengalanātha by Ialavāyi Gangapa-Nayaka, the agent of the mahāmandaleswara Gōburi Tirumalarajayadeva-Mahaarasu, and the mahanaṇu including the gauda, the śenabōya and the (paṭṇan-svāmi) of the village.

cells.place: On another slab in the place of Timma-ppa †
cells.date: Śaka 143[0], Sukla, Śravaṇa, śu. di., 10, Thurs-day.
cells.remarks: Do. Incomplete. Mentions the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara and the village referred to in No. 704 above.

cells.place: On a slab lying near a well in the same village (as Timma-ppa temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 143[0], Sukla, Śravaṇa, śu. di., 10, Thurs-day.
cells.remarks: Do. Records a grant of land by Badōkhan Nayaka Saheb to one Chennappa for having repaired a well and for its future up-keep.

cells.location: Bolagoti
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Basavēśvarasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Do. Records a grant of land by Badōkhan Nayaka Saheb to one Chennappa for having repaired a well and for its future up-keep.

cells.location: Holalagundi
cells.place: On a slab in the Keśavasvāmin temple
cells.date: Ch. Vik 50, Viśvā-vasu, Māgha su. di. 1, Friday, Solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of land, a garden, a well and an oil-mill for offerings, worship and repairs in the temple of Brah-meśvaradeva by the Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara Dēśavarman-deva of the Kaśyapa-gōtra who bore the title 'Holalakonde' and had his capital at Holalakonde.

cells.location: Kanchagara-Belagallu
cells.place: On a gaddige-kallu lying near the chavaḍi
cells.date: Śaka 1639, Hema-lambi, Kartika, ba. di., 2, Saturday, Rohipi, Amrita-Siddha-yōga, Taitulakarana.
cells.remarks: Records the commencement of the construction of the temple of Bhōgēśvara, of a well, a tank on the road to Adavāni and the gift of land by Aiyyana, son of Kullakāri Hayappa Narasamma of Kanchagara-Belagallu.

cells.place: On a slab lying near the Ādijēśva-svāmin temple in the same village (as Keśavasvāmin temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 903, Vikrama, Vaiśakha, śu. di., 5, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Records the revival of the former grants of land and made the gift of land to the temple, etc., and also registers the gift of lands to Kēśavadēva, a form of Vishnu temple by Dharavaladēvi, wife of Vīra-Nolamba-Pallava-Permmā-naḍidēva of the Pallava family who had the title 'the lord of Kāñchīpura'.

cells.place: On a boulder called 'Bōḍhe-guṇḍu' near Ādijēśva-svāmin temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 969, Sarvajit, Vaiśākha, Amāvāsya, Friday, Solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land, to the temple of Viṣṇudēva of Naguṇḍi, by the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Gaṇḍarādityarasa who had the title 'the lord of Mahishmatīpura' and who was ruling the Sindavāḍi 1000, Beṇḍevura 12 and [Nu]ru-guṇḍu.

cells.place: On a boulder near the entrance into the same village (as Ādijēśva-svāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land and well. Mentions the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Koṇḍapa-Nāyaka and the villages Siruguppa and Kamōgāra-Belagalu.

cells.place: On a boulder in a field to the south-west of the village of Gejjēhalli.
cells.date: Śaka 1[5]53, Pramodūta, Kartika, śu. di., 13, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to four individuals to maintain a flower-garden and a well. Mentions Yallapa-Nāyaka the agent of Mākāhahi of Gajjahalli, who was again the agent of Bābāsheh, Killeḍār of Adavāni.

cells.location: Vandavagilli
cells.place: On a stone set up in the Byadam-kōri
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Records the lease of land granted to the gauda, the mahājana and the citizens of Vandavagilli by Chennana-Nāyaka, the agent of Timma-Nāyaka, the son of Vīra-Panna-Nāyaka.

cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the west of the village of Hebbetam.
cells.date: Śaka 1517, Manmatha, Vaiśakha, ba. di., 10. [date-calculation appendix, No. 715: Śaka 1239, Piṅgala, Jyēshṭha, śu. 8, Thursday = A.D. 1317, May 19, Thursday; ·41.]
cells.remarks: Records the grant of lands to a private individual by the gauḍa, sōnabōva, talavāra and the ayagāras of Hebbetu for having constructed a tank when there was scarcity of water for cattle in the village.

cells.place: On a stone set up near the Bhōgē-śvarasvāmin temple in the same village (as Ādijēśva-svāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In Chālukyan characters. Gift of lands by purchase.

cells.location: Neraniki
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Kalla-rayya temple
cells.date: Śaka 1198, 5th year, Dhatu, Chaitra, śu. di., 1, Tuesday.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of lands for offerings to the temple of Kalinathadēva and for the maintenance of a feeding-house, by Lakhumidēva-Nāyaka, the sarvadhikāri of Vāsudēva.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the Sunk-lamma temple in the same village (as Kalla-rayya temple). †
cells.date: Saka 1209, [17th] Sarvajit, Sivarati di. 15, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 718: Śaka 1198, [Dha]tu, Mārga [śira], ba. 7, Thursday— A.D. 1276, November 13, Friday; f.d.t. ·53. The week-day in the inscription seems to be a mistake.]
cells.remarks: Records the gift of two pana on every ten pack bullocks by the merchants of Vira-Narayana-pura Tumbala-pattana to the Mahamandalacharya Nagayya-natha, son of Kummaya-dasi, for the merit of the king. Mentions the temple of the village granted to Nagayya in Sindavadi-nadu. Muthalad. In archaie characters of about the 11th century. Mentions the names of some gavundas.

cells.place: On another slab near the Kallava-yana temple in the place of Sunk-lamma. †
cells.remarks: Fixes by lease the rent and due to Lingayya the agent of Bacharasa, from the gauda and the people of the village of Kurukundi for having reconstituted the village ruined by Madayya.

cells.place: On a slab built into the side of Ambar-bavi at Kottapeta, ham-let of Kurukundi.
cells.remarks: Records the appointment on contract, of Linga-jiya Nandi-jiva for worship in the temple of Bhimesvaradeva at Kurukundi by Kondappa, the agent of Bacharasa.

cells.location: Kurukundi
cells.place: On a slab near the Anjaneya-svamin temple
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a land tax on bathers at Kuru-kundi situated in Adavani-sime. Muthalad. In archaic characters of about the 9th century.

cells.place: On a stone set up near the Bhime-svarasvamin temple in the same village (as Anjaneya-svamin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a land tax on bathers at Kuru-kundi situated in Adavani-sime. Muthalad. In archaic characters of about the 9th century.

cells.location: Pallichchandai, Sivaganga taluk, Ramanathapuram district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Polappa temple in the same village (as Bhime-svarasvamin temple). †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of wat and dry lands to a private individual.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the Ohalis-varasvamin temple in the same village (as Polappa temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the Kavon-Nayaka for having constructed a tank.

cells.location: Mankurti — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab near the Anjano-yasvamin temple
cells.remarks: Records the gift of some lands and other customary offerings to the temple of Anjaneya-Janardanadeva at Huliyutun situated in the Hoota-sime which was best-owed on Ramaraja-Koneti-Timmaraja.
