cells.location: Hulibidu
cells.place: On a beam over the entrance door into the temple of Abhaladesvara-svamin temple
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of land to certain bavas for the cons-truction of a tank and channels and the upkeep thereof, a house-site.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a field to the west of the village of Blebalu.
cells.remarks: Muthalad. The Mahamandalasvara Sakeradeva Seema to record a grant of land, a garden, an oil-mill and a house-site.

cells.location: Kuruvalli
cells.place: On a broken slab lying near the Anja-dyasvamin temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Recr. grant of land to certain artisans attached to the temple of Chennakesavadeva for the merit of Silliniraja Srirangara jayadeva-maharaja.

cells.location: Mankurti
cells.place: On a slab built into the wall of the Anjaneyasvamin temple
cells.date: Saka 1479, Pingala, Kārtika, ba. di., [date-calculation appendix, No. 729: Saka 1479, Piṅgala, Kārtika, śu. di., dvādaśi. Details not enough for verification.]
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of certain lands by the King of the village of the temple of Anjaneya-Janardanadeva and to the choultry which was resorted to by the Brahmans travel-ling by the military route (dandudora).

cells.location: Halligara
cells.place: On a slab near the Anjaneya-svamin temple
cells.remarks: Mutilated and damaged. Seems to register the money and grain income in the village of Haligara belonging to Adavani-durga which was held by the Mahamandalasvara Srirangaraja, son of Siddhiraja Aubalaraja as an amara-umbali. The choultry which Késava-Perumal at Haliharavi and the choultry which was also resorted to by itinerant Brahmans travelling by the military rug.

cells.place: On another slab in the place of Anjaneya-svamin †
cells.remarks: Mutilated and damaged. Seems to register the money and grain income in the village of Haligara belonging to Adavani-durga which was held by the Mahamandalasvara Srirangaraja, son of Siddhiraja Aubalaraja as an amara-umbali. The choultry which Késava-Perumal at Haliharavi and the choultry which was also resorted to by itinerant Brahmans travelling by the military rug.

cells.location: Nagaruru
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Iśvara temple
cells.date: Śaka 1176, Ānanda, Āshāḍha, śu. di., 11, Monday.
cells.remarks: Registers the revival of the previous, grant of land to the chontry of Sōmanāth dēva by the Mahāpradhāna and Sarvvādhikāri Jōgama-Rāhuta who was ruling the Sinda-vāḍi nāḍu.

cells.place: On the slab of Iśvara †
cells.date: Śaka 1177, Rākshasa, Āshāḍha, śu. di., 11, Monday.
cells.remarks: Seems to register a gift of land to the temple of Siddha-Sōmanāthadēva at Nagaruru by a certain Pāpuṇidēva.

cells.place: On another slab in the place of Iśvara.. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a grant of land in Nagamaṅgala. Mentions Toṇdaimān Muttarasa and a Chai'ya temple.

cells.location: Chinna-Hoṭuru
cells.place: On the Garuḍa-kambha set up in front of the Chennakēśava temple
cells.remarks: Seems to provide for offerings in the temple of Ādikēśva-nātha consecrated by Pratapa Harihararaya.

cells.location: Tedda-Hoṭuru
cells.place: On the wall to the left of the entrance into the Lakshmīnārāyaṇasvāmin temple
cells.date: Śaka 1463, Plava, Kārtika, śu. di., 12, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of land for offerings in the temple of Lakshmīnārāyaṇadēva at Sauganapuram.

cells.place: On the Garuḍa-kambha set up in front of the Añjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1681, Pramathi, Srāvaṇa, ba. di., 8, Friday, Rohiṇi.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the Garuḍa-kambha was set up by Machirēḍi. The village is called Hire-Hoṭuru.

cells.place: On the Garuḍa-kambha set up in front of the Añjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village (as Lakshmīnārāyaṇasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a Vināyaka-pillar (Vināyaka kambha) by Dēvarasa, son of Keroya-Naganna of Nagaradōne.

cells.location: Suluvayi
cells.place: On a slab lying near the Kallēśvara-svāmin temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the gift of some land and cash income to Kalinathadēva by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Tirumalarāja Rāmadēvarāyadēva-Mahārasu with the consent of all people.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the south wall of Arjuṇalingēśvara temple
cells.date: 23rd year, Mithuna, śu. di., tritiya, Friday, Pusbya.
cells.remarks: Records that the images of Kuttađuvar and his consort set up in the temple in the 22nd year, were consecrated and that provision was made for worship by Ku[pa]karayar, son of Maļayarāyar. Mentions the assembly of Kundadēvi-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya below Velurkulam in Madurōdaya-vaļanađu, a dēvadana of Muđivaļangu-l'āṇdiya Ísvaramnđaiya-Nāyaṇar.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Arjuṇalingēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 20+1st year, Karkaṭaka, 8, ba. di., ekadasi, Rohiṇi.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a sale of land by the assembly mentioned in No. 740 above to Kuttaṇ Tennadan alias Trihhuvanaśingadēva residing in Kaṇnanūr in Maļai-maṇdalam. Mentions the temple of Mušugupattiruva-ramiśuram-uđuiya-Naya[nār].

cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Vaidyanātha temple at Tirumalavadi (Udayarpalayam taluk, Trichinopoly district).
cells.date: 10th year [date-calculation appendix, No. 1: Mathematical instrument box No. 2 supplied by the Public Works Secretariat.]
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a silver salver for betel offerings to the temple of Tirumaḻavāḍi-Uḍaiyār by the queen (?) Nakkan Tillaiaḻagiyār alias Śōḻamādēviyār. Mentions the standard weight called Vaiyagattārkkal.

cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp to the temple of Tirumaḻavāḍi-Mahādēva.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Records a similar gift to the same temple. Tirumaḻavāḍi is stated to have been situated in Poygai-nāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of a gong to the temple of Tirumaḻavāḍi-Āḻvār by a private individual.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp by a native of Poṇḍāyil in Miṟai-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Records a gift of a lamp to the temple by a native of Pullamaṅgalam in Kiḻār-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Records the gift of a copper-image of Kolgaidēva and a silver plate for betel at the śrībali offerings.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by purchase, for a lamp to the temple by a certain Ariñjigaikēṇi, daughter of 'Mutta-Uḍaiyār.'

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp to the same temple by a native of Kiḻśeṅgiḻi-nāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: A similar gift of sheep for a perpetual lamp. Tirumaḻavāḍi is said to be a dēvadāna in Miypi[ḷā]ṟu which was a sub-division of Po[y]gai-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the west wall of Vaidyanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a gold-flower and a gold sword to the image of Mahādēva by two private individuals.

cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of gold for offerings to the god and for feeding five persons on the Tiruvadirai day in the temple. Fragment. Seems to register a gift for a lamp. Mentions Porakkādu in Arkkatṭuk-kūrgam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Stones displaced at the right end. Records a gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Tirumaḻuvāḍi-Perumānaḍigaḷ by Iḷaṅgōn Pichchi, the senior queen of "Śōḻapperumānār" and the daughter of Vallavaraiyar.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.date: 27th year, Tulā, Saturday, Bharaṇi. [date-calculation appendix, No. 14: 1919-20]
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp to the same temple by a certain Pariśaikiḻān Nakkan Siṅga[dēvan] of Parivaṇḍatturai in Ārkkāṭṭu-kūṟṟam, who purchased it from the assembly of Marapiḍugu-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Intercepted by pillars. Gift of sheep for a lamp to the same temple by a native of Tañjāvūr.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: A similar gift of sheep for a lamp to the temple by a certain Kāman Tāyan, a teacher (vatti) of Iḍaiyār.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, by purchase, to the temple of Tirumaḻavāḍi-Mahādēva by a certain Āyiravan Ēnādi, the headman of Ārkkāḍu in Porakkāḍu, a sub-division of Ārkkāṭṭuk-kūṟṟam. Mentions Vaṭṭanārkuḍi, a brahmadēya in Poygai-nāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Vaidyanātha †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, by purchase, to the temple of Tirumaḻavāḍi-Mahādēva by a certain Āyiravan Ēnādi, the headman of Ārkkāḍu in Porakkāḍu, a sub-division of Ārkkāṭṭuk-kūṟṟam. Mentions Vaṭṭanārkuḍi, a brahmadēya in Poygai-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Vaidyanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Built at the beginning. Begins with the introduction 'Tirumagal-pola', etc. Registers the appointment by royal order of certain Chandrabhana Bhatta for an additional Saivacharyakkai in the temple at Tirumala-vadi in Poygai-nadu a sub-division of Pavattur-nadu.

cells.place: On the north wall of the Utsava-vigraha shrine adjoining the central shrine in Vaidyanātha temple. †
cells.date: 19th year, Misha ba. di., pratha-ma, Monday, Anuradha.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, by purchase, to a certain individual for bringing a pot of water from the Kaveri daily for the sacred bath of the image in the temple of Tirumalapadi in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajaraja-valanadu, by one of the donors living in the same village.

cells.place: On the wall of Utsava-vigraha (inside) †
cells.date: 16th year, Vrishabha, di., dvadasi, Friday, Bharani. [date-calculation appendix, No. 21: 16th year, Kumbha, ba. di., ēkādaśī, Friday, Bharaṇi = A.D. 1271, June 5; ·10; ·58.]
cells.remarks: Records similar gift of land for the same purpose by a brother-in-law of the Viraya Danayanaka, the Mahapradhani of the king.

cells.place: On the north and west walls of Utsava-vigraha shrine. †
cells.date: 26th year, Kumba, su. di., saptami, Wednesday, Revati. [date-calculation appendix, No. 22: Salukkai]
cells.remarks: Another gift of land by purchase for the same purpose by Paragamana alias Irunakuran who had the kavalkani of Tirumalapadi alias Jinachintamani-nallur which was a dévalaya of the temple. Records also some previous gifts by the same person, viz., a brass vessel (sinnakkodai), a bell, two sounding horns, a bamboo (tiruvadippadi), a mirror, a sounding conch and five lamps.

cells.place: On the west wall of Utsava-vigraha shrine. †
cells.date: 25th year, Vrishchika, di., dasi, Thursday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Another gift of land for providing a pot of water daily from the Kaveri for the sacred bath of the god by a certain Palaiya-Nayakar.

cells.place: On the wall of Utsava-vigraha †
cells.date: 24th year, Karka, di., panchami, Monday, Rohini. [date-calculation appendix, No. 24: 24th year, Kanya, ba. di., pañchamī, Monday, Rōhiṇī = A.D. 1239, September 19; ·67; ·83.]
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Gift of land by two residents of Nerkunram to Tirumalapadi, a sub-division of Poygai-nadu alias Kulottunga-sola-valanadu in Jayangonda-solamandalam.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Utsava-vigraha shrine. †
cells.date: 26th 1st year, Karkataka, su. di., trayodasi, Sunday, Punarvasu. [date-calculation appendix, No. 25: 26 + 1st year, Karkaṭaka, ba. di., trayōdaśī, Sunday, Punarvasu = A.D. 1242, July 27; ·28; ·19.]
cells.remarks: Built at the right end. Records a tax-free gift of land by a merchant of Eripattayam in Mala-mandalam for maintaining a well, a water-trough and a servant for drawing water in the south gate of the third prakara for devotees to wash their feet before entering the temple.

cells.place: On the south wall of Utsava-vigraha shrine. †
cells.date: Saka 1409, Phalguna, su. di., dvitiya, Ba. di., tritiya, Monday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to a dancing woman for service in the temple, by Konerideva-Maharaja.

cells.place: On the wall of Utsava-vigraha †
cells.date: 5th 1st year, Vrishabha, su. di., panchami, Monday, Chitra.
cells.remarks: Gift of land by purchase for two lamps to the temple of Tirumalapadi Udaiyar by a resident of Koyyur in Kunn-kurram, a sub-division of Uttungatunga-valanadu.

cells.place: On the right wall of the Ganapati shrine in Utsava-vigraha shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold for the arbali offerings by a certain Parisalakkan Ayiravan Padaiyaliyan of Parivandurai in Arpattuk-kuttam on the southern bank of the Kaveri.

cells.place: On the west wall of the Jvaratara shrine in Ganapati shrine. †
cells.date: 3rd year, Vrischika, ba. di., chaturdasi, Sunday, Asvati.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Rajagambhiramangalam separated from Nittavinodallur, for a pot of Kaveri-water for the sacred bath of the lord of Tirumulavadi by the wife of Arasur Nallari Kadu-Bhattan of Gandanaditta-chaturvedimangalam.

cells.place: On the east, north and west walls of Chandesvara shrine in Jvaratara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Seems to record a gift of land by certain Brahmans of Marudanila-chaturvedimangalam, a village in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajendra-singa-valanadu.

cells.place: In the third gopura leading into the central shrine, left of entrance, same temple.
cells.date: 3rd year, Vrischika, ba. di., dvitiya, Saturday, Rohini.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for fetching two pot-fuls of water daily from the Kaveri for the sacred bath of the lord of Tirumulavadi by Arayan Pavalakkunran alias Eduttalai Alagiyan of Valamar alias Vambanallur in Kavar-kurram, a sub-division of Geyavinoda-valanadu by a native of Tiruvellarai in Kavi-nadu.

cells.place: On the gopura of Chandesvara, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: End built in. Begins with the introduction, 'Pugalmada-vilar', etc. Records remission of certain taxes on lands granted for feeding the Gangaikonda-solan in the temple by the great assembly of Goydaraditta-chaturvedimangalam, a brahmadeyam in Poygai-nadu, sub-division of Rajendra-singa-valanadu who also met at the hall called Uttamachola-mandapam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the gopura of Chandesvara, right of entrance. †
cells.date: 26th year, Karkataka, ba. di., dvadasi, Sunday, Maga.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Nitinodamangalam for two pots of Kaveri-water for the sacred-bath of the lord of Tirumulavadi by Pinbagaiyar, Iradingadevan, one of the Karkkolars of Tanjavur-mangalam in Karungudi-nadu, a sub division of Chola-mandalam.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the gopura of Chandesvara, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction, 'Pugalmada-vilar', etc. Records a gift of land for a perpetual lamp to the lord of Tirumulavadi in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajendrasinga-valanadu, by Ilagolayal, daughter of Valavanarayar Manaiyar Kalingarayar alias Mummudichola-Udaiyar-marayan of Nallur.

cells.place: On the gōpura of Chandesvara, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introducti n “Pachhaer”, etc. Gift of paddy for offerings to the image of Pillaiyar Tirujānasambandaīgal, Tirunavnkkaraiyadēva and Nambi Ārīnarar set up in the temple by Tirumalaraṅgan alias Tiruppalītitamapichchān and his lady.

cells.place: On the east and north walls of the first prākāra of Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.date: 29th year, Mithuna, su. di., tritiyā, Monday, Punarvasu.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Gift of land in Naduvirandur, a hamlet of Gandarāditya-chaturvēdimangalam for the maintenance of the person who had to bring a pot of water from the Kāvēri for the sacred-bath and offerings to the image of Thēvaparichchhegra-set up in the verandah on the north side of the first prākāra of this temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Chandesvara. †
cells.date: 20th year, Karkațaka, ba. di., pañchadasi, Monday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Gift of land by purchase for a perpetual lamp to the temple of Tirumalavadi in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajaraja-valanadu by Vallaya Daṇda-nāyaka, son of Dūtappillai Dandanāyakkar of Aranaipuram, one of the pradhānis of Vira-Narasimhadēva.

cells.place: In the third gōpura, leading into the central shrine, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Gives in a single verse the praise of the chief Gopaya-Tippe who was a great philanthropist to the poor and the poets.

cells.place: On the north wall of the first prākāra.
cells.date: [1] 3 Mēsha, śu. di, saptami, Saturday, Ālēsha.
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Gift of land for the maintenance of the person bringing raw water for the secared-bath of the god at Tirunavaladi by Dēvanayaka thia Dēvanāpurumal, son of Kalyāṇidär of Totti, an am of the followers of Mahāpradhāni Vira Dan danāyaka.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Gift of land for the maintenance of the person bringing a pot of water from the Kāvēri for the sacred-bath. Mentions the Mahāpradhani Viraṇa Daṇdanāyaka.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 28 + 1st year, Mīna, śu. di., chaturdaśi, Monday, Uttara-Phalguni.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Rājarājapuram which was separated from Vikramasōlanallur, a hamlet of Anjukāḍiya-chaturvēdimangalam for meeting expenses of offerings and of making a garden for the sacred-bath of the god of Tirunavaladi in Poygai-nādu, a sub-division of Rājarājavalanādu, by Pūgan Vikramanādatlan Vāyakan, a native of Manabārananallur of Tolu-rājya.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: Śaka 1855, Prama-dicha, Mithuna, śu. di, dvitiya, Friday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Beginning not engraved on the wall. Seems to register a gift of land by purchase for offering-cakes to the image of Ālingya-pillaiyār set up in the temple by one of the Karmakars.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. registers a gift of land for the maintenance of the person bringing one pot of water for the sacred-bath of the lord of Tirumaļavādi.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prakara of Chandesvara. †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Tamil

cells.place: On the west wall of the prakara of Chandesvara. †
cells.date: 19th year, Rishabha, su. di., dvitiya, Wednesday, Mrigasira.
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Ponnārmēnivilagam separated from Ulaguyyavandhunallūr, a hamlet of Gandarāditya-chaturvēdimangalam for one pot of Kavēri-water for the sacred-bath of the god at Tirumalavadi by Udattūrudaiyan Tirucchirgambalamundaiyan alias Kunakarāyan.

cells.place: On the same wall.
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land for the sacred-bath in Ediriliśoļa .. separated from Kodandarāma-nallūr, a hamlet of Gandarāditya-chaturvēdimangalam. One of the donors was a native of Naduvil Kavēri in Arkadu-kūrgam, a sub-division of Tenkarui Pāndikulasani-valunadn.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara. †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Records that the mandapa was constructed by Rajanganda son of Abhimanattunga Raya Basava-sankara who was the brudas pattakkattari, Kanchipura-varadhivara, etc.

cells.place: On the south wall of Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land in Udayan and Anganangalam for offerings by Sevvappa Malavarayanalgal. Refers to an earlier gift of land for offerings to Aravattanivar (63 Saiva devotees).

cells.place: On the west wall of Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Pēr-Arasūr as a devadana to the (images of) Nayanmar set up in front of the temple after paying certain amount into the treasury of Koneridēva-Maharaja.

cells.place: On the left wall of entrance of the kitchen room, same temple.
cells.date: Mesha, su. di., chatur-dasi, Friday, Hasta.
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land by purchase in Nittavinodamangalam for offerings to the image of Bhikshataandēva set up in the temple by Nerkuppai-Udaiyan Aravimudu Periya Nayan alias Nārpattonnayiranambi.

cells.place: In the second gopura of Chandesvara shrine, right of entrance. †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Kulottninga-śoļanallūr for the maintenance of the person bringing one pot of Kavēri-water for the sacred bath by Vejūr Kilaran Rajarajedēvan.

cells.place: In the place of Chandesvara †
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Remission of taxes on lands belonging to the temple by Naya Basavašankara Koneridēva-Mahaaja who bears the birudas pattukkattāri, etc. The amount remitted had to be utilised for the great worship (Mahapūja) and repairs in the temple.

cells.place: left of entrance.
cells.date: 31st year, Mesha, su. di., chaturthi, Wednesday, Rohini.
cells.language: 18th year, Rishabhc, ba. di., pafichami, Monlay, Ultarashadhā.
cells.remarks: Records lands brought under cultivation for perpetual lamps given to the temple. Mentions the liquid measure 'Sembiyana-Madadevi'.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records lands brought under cultivation for perpetual lamps given to the temple. Mentions the liquid measure 'Sembiyana-Madadevi'.

cells.place: On the gōpura of Chandesvara, left of entrance. †
cells.date: 12th year, Makara ba. di. tritiyā, Monday, Maḷha.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for the maintenance of the person bringing a pot of Tirumanjanam daily for the sacred-bath of the lord of Tirunallāru by Singalattaraiyan.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the gōpura of Chandesvara, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a similar grant.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the gōpura of Chandesvara, left of entrance. †
cells.date: [15]th year, Karka-ṭaka, sū. dl., saptami, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land by purchase by a Dandanāyaka at the service of rousing the god from sleep (tiruppalli-eluchchi), for the merit of the king.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the gōpura of Chandesvara, left of entrance. †
cells.date: 36th year, Mithuna, ba. di., chatur-daśī, Sunday, Rōhiṇī.
cells.remarks: Mathilated in the beginning. Gift of land for maintaining a flower garden by the wife of a Brahman servant of the temple of Tirukkalā-Udaiyar in Siruvīravēḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the east wall of the second prākāra, right of entrance, Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. The inscription begins with the introduction "Śgutšār" etc. Gift of 14 kāšu and vessels for early morning-offerings in the temple at Tirumajavādi, in l'oygai-nādu, a sub-division of Rajendraśinga-vaļa adu by Tirumal Araṅgup alias Tiruppallitāmapichohap. Below this, is another inscription dated in the 31st year of the same king referring to a gift of jaddy for the same offerings.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction 'Tirumanni-valara' etc. Sale of land to the temple by Mōgilayan Kōvan Suvaran of Amaravīdi, amōdharakārikudi, a brāhmaṇadāya in Guṇḍavēḷi-chaturvēdimangalam, in Poygai-nāḍu, a subdivision of Vaḍagarai Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction 'Tirumanni-valara' etc. Sale of land to the temple by a Brahman lady.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction 'Tirumanni-valara' etc. Sale of land to the temple by Varrāḷūr Mādēva Dāsipuryan.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction 'Tirumanni-valara' etc. Sale of land to the temple by Mōḍi Amantāranāyaṇan of Mahimabhannachāri Kandiyān, a sub-division of Gaṇḍarāditya-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadāya of Vaḍagarai Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction 'Tirumanni-valara' etc. Sale of land to the temple by a private individual of Alaṅgūr.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Vaidyanathadeva at Tiromalavadi, by a shepherd Vambanolai alias Uttanasjjakkon.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Gift of land for offering milk at the early morning service by a servant of the king.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Gift of a gold ornament set with jewels to the temple at Tirumalavadi by a Brahman lady of Mirangur. Records also the gift of a jewelled ornament and a gold-flower in the 19th year of the king.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. The inscription begins with the introduction “ĝgetšear” etc. Gift of a silver armour (kavacham) to be used at the three sacred-baths and 30 kāsu for one perpetual lamp by Anukkisūrri[ya] Pañchavañ Madevi.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: Gift of a pearl umbrella to the god at Tirumalavadi, a devadana in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajendra-singa-valanadu by Madurantakadevan Arunmolinangaiyar alias I'angar, daughter of Rajendra-Choladeva.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the same wall, left of entrance
cells.remarks: Gift of land by purchase for feeding a pot of water from the Kaveri for the sacred-bath of the god in the temple at Tirumalavadi in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Vuda-garai Rajaraja-valanadu by a lady of Aragalur in Arror-kogram.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and built in at the bottom. The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Makes provision for feeding Sivayogins and Mahesvaras on the days of Masi-Maham and Tiruvai-nakkani festivals.

cells.place: On the same wall, right of entrance
cells.remarks: Much damaged. The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Gift of 30 kasu and two lamp-stands for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirumalavadi.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara, right of entrance †
cells.remarks: Built in at the bottom. The inscription begins with the introduction "Tirumanni-valara" etc. Mentions the lands lying waste in the 21st year, but brought under cultivation for feeding Sivayogins and Mahesvaras, by the order of the midday-offering, by a servant of Rajendra-Choladeva named Viracola Nallurudaiyan Nanorruvan Yanaramp of Viracholanalur in Tirokinjamala-nadu, a sub-division of Rajendrasinga-valanadu.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Chandesvara. †
cells.date: 3rd year, Makara, śu. di., ēkādaśi, Saturday, Rōhiṇi.
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction "Tirumanni valara". Gift of land for offerings, festivals and Bower garlands to the image of Aḍavallār Pillaiyār in the temple of Tirumalavāḍi-Uḍaiyār by Vaṇḍanāyagan, grandson of Paṭṭamuḍaiyān Arayan Uttamaśōla Gāngēyarāyan of Āvūr-kūṟṟam in Nittavinōda-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: [10]th year, Tula, ba. di, shashṭi, Friday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land for providing two pots of water for the kaḍru-bath.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to be a copy of the old record. Begins with the introduction "Tirumanni valara" etc. Gift of land for daily worship of the images of Jayangoṇḍa-śōḷa-viṇṇagar and his consort, set up by one of the managers of the temples of Mahā-Vishṇu and Mahādēva at the village of Tirumalavāḍi-Uḍaiyār, in the chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmādēya in Pōygaināḍu, a sub-division of Rājēndraśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu which assembled in the temple of Gaṇḍarāditya-Viṇṇagar.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 4th year, Siṁha, ba. di., ashṭami, Monday, Rōhiṇi.
cells.remarks: Unfinished and damaged. Begins with the introduction "Tirumanni valara" etc. Gift of land for joining a grove of trees to the god "Tirumalavāḍi-Uḍaiyār" to stop in after mortifying the hunger in the Kāviri.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of 91 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 4th year, Tula, ba. di., tritiya, Sunday, Krittika.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "Pūmādu puṇara" etc. Gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp by a native of Iḍaiyāṟṟūr in Taṇḍināḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.king: Parakēsarivarman alias Tribhuvana-chakravartin Kuḷōttunga-Chōḷadēva, (who was pleased to take Madura and the crowned head of the Pāṇḍya).
cells.date: [1]th year, Dha-nus, ba. di., dada-mi, Thursday, Viśākha.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of land by a merchant of Dēva-chintāmaṇi-chaturvēdimangalam for the daily worship of the image of Bhikshāṭanadēva set up by his father who died before connecting it.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Records that the gift of 198 sheep for 2 lamps ordered in the 15th year of Pariyadevar Kulōttunga-Choladēva, 'who sholished tell' was engraved on stone now.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged and unfinished. Gift of 90 sheep for burning a lamp in the temple by Tyāgasundari, daughter of Nujam-bar.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "Tingaler-per-valara" etc. Gift of land for a perpetual lamp by Aruḷāḷan Jayangoṇḍaśōḷiyār alias Paḍhavāṇamudaiyār, wife of Sūḷavaḷanādēva, who is called son (pillaiyār).

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Chandesvara. †
cells.remarks: Records that Kauśiyandēvan Kūttan alias Gaṇḍarāditta Bhaṭṭan, one of the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple took charge of certain lamps including the one given by Tiruvēgambamuḍaiyār alias Tyāgasundari in the 4th year of Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷadēva. The price of one sheep is stated to be 48 kāśu.

cells.location: Ādigudi, Lalgudi taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 21st year, Mithuna, śu. di., ashṭamī, Sunday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Contains a portion of the introduction of Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷa III. Gift of land for a perpetual lamp to the temple by a native of Urattūr-kūṟṟam in Kōnāḍu alias [Iraṭṭa]pāḍikoṇḍaśōḻa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land in Anapāyanallūr for conducting worship to Vayichchiyanāthapperumāḷ in this temple by Avaḷavaḷinallūr Uḍaiyān Perumān Tiruvēgambamuḍaiyān.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 10th year, Kumbha, ba. di., tritīyā, Śravaṇa.
cells.remarks: The inscription stops with the name of the king and the date.

cells.place: On the west wall of the prākāra of Chandesvara. †
cells.remarks: Refers to the lamps given during the reigns of Rājēndra-Chōḷadēva and Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷadēva, 'who abolished tolls.' Seems to provide for maintaining the lamps given during the time of Periyadēvar Rājarājadēva, as the recipients of the sheep died and their assignees could not either be found out or were unable to maintain the lamps.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 6 + 1st year, Kumbha, ba. di., chaturthī, Monday, Svāti.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a house at Tirumaḻavāḍi to Kuṉṟūruḍaiyān Teṟṟi Periyan alias Edirilisōḻamūvēndavēḷār who owned lands in Kuṉṟa-kōṭṭam alias Uttuṅgatoṅga-vaḷanāḍu but who was required to reside in Tirumaḻavāḍi guarding the place. He appears to have extended the temple and certain maṇḍapas as the space within them was very narrow.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.date: 4th year, Siṁha, ba. di., ashṭamī, Monday Rōhiṇi.
cells.remarks: Begins with the historical introduction "[Tamil script]" etc. Records the registering of the dēvadāna lands purchased from the tenants for arrears of rent. The dēvadāna included also other lands given to the image of Vayichchiyanādīśvaram-uḍaiya-Nāyanār set up in the temple by Eyiṟpākkiḻaiyan Embirān Śambandar, one of the Māhēśvaras.

cells.place: On the south wall of the second prākāra of Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Begins with the introduction "Pāṣṭṭṭṭṭ Pāṣṭṭ" etc. Seems to register the number of sheep given and the quantity of ghee to be measured out for the 3? perpetual lamps given to the temple of Tirumalavādi-Uḍaiya-Mahadēva in Foygainaḍu, a sub-division of Kulōttunga-sōla-valanaḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Sale of land for a flower-garden and its maintenance.

cells.place: On the south wall of the prakara of Chandesvara. †
cells.date: 17th year, Makara, su. di., Skadadi, Wednesday, Anuradha.
cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp to the temple of Tirumalavadi in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajarajavala-nadu. The donor was Pallavarayan Madavidagal Kamadeva alias Uttamachola Pallavarayan of Puliyur-nadu in Puliyur-kottam alias Kulottungachola-valanadu, a district of Jayangonda-solamandalam.

cells.place: On the wall of Chandesvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction 'Tirumagal polaperu' etc. Gift of 90 sheep and a ram for a perpetual lamp to the lord of Tirumalavadi by Vilajavandar alias Akilabhuvana-vanodayar of Paruvayur-nadu in Puliyur-nadu a sub-division of Rajarajavala-valanadu.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Sundaram-bal shrine in Chandesvara shrine. †
cells.date: 2[9]th year, Tula, śu. di., trayōdaśi, Monday.
cells.remarks: Seems to register a gift of land to the temple.

cells.place: On the east wall of the ruined mandapa to the north of the shrine of the goddess in Sundaram-bal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a gift of gold for offering crushed rice (aval) on the day of Ardra in the month of Margali to Ganapati by Kendala Vellala Pillaiyar of Kumbal-jumbur in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Rajarajavala-nadu.

cells.place: On the first gopura of Sundaram-bal shrine, right of entrance. †
cells.date: 7th year, Kanya, ba. di., navami, Friday, Punarvasu.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Gift of land for repairs to the temple, the mandapa and the prakara, wall called Periya-nattan-tirumadi by the citizens of Vivai-nadu, a sub-division of Poygai-nadu in the district of Rajaraja-valanadu.

cells.location: Kundadam, Dharapuram taluk, Coimbatore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the place of Sundaram-bal, left of entrance †

cells.place: In the place of Sundaram-bal, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: Begisters a gift of land for repairs to the temple.

cells.location: Pallichchhandai
cells.place: In the place of Sundaram-bal, left of entrance †

cells.remarks: Records an assignment of certain taxes for conducting repair to the temple. Tirumalavadi was situated in Poygai-nadu, a sub-division of Vadagarai Rajaraja-vala-nadu alias Sundara-Pandya Malavarayan figures as one of the signatories.

cells.location: Adigudi, Laigudi taluk, same district
cells.place: On the east wall of Athukuresvara temple
cells.remarks: A Sanskrit verse in praise of the god.

cells.place: On the left side of the same doorway.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for feeding 25 Brahmans on the seven festival days in the month of Madi, to the temple of Tirubhattaraka at Tiruvadudai, a brahmadeya in Kil-kuru, a sub-division of Kalara-kuru, a district of Vadagarai Mala-nadu

cells.remarks: Records that Chinnayya Kavaṇḍaṉ, a resident of Nīlāli, reconstructed in stone the Śiva temple which had formerly been built of brick and wood and had consequently gone to ruins.

cells.location: Karukkaipalayam

cells.remarks: Records that the temple of Nāgēśvaramuḍaiyār at Kuṇiyūr was repaired by Avuḍaiyār after its desecration by the Muhammadans.

Pirantakapuram alias Rajarajapuram is mentioned and the signatory's name is given as Ainiya-nalagan alias Vāṇadhirājan of Siru-nāranallūr in Kañjui-irukkai.

cells.location: Daļavāyapattanam, Dharapuram taluk, Coimbatore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another beam in Viṇu-ṇagaram-perumaḷ temple. †

cells.place: On a pillar in the Agastyēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Mentions that Tirunilakanthan alias Tillaivajum-andapanambi gave the pillar as a gift.

cells.place: On another pillar in Agastyēśvara temple. †

cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to record gift of rice and kambu for offerings to god. Sōḻiyaṉāḻi is mentioned as a standard measure.

cells.place: On the south wall of Vināyaka temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to provide for the supply of kambu grain for offerings to the god.

cells.location: Arasan-palayam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the central shrine in the Palvaṇḍa-varavaram temple
cells.remarks: Records gift of one kalañju of gold to a certain Brahman in the temple by a merchant living in Iraṭṭakuḷam-uḍaiyāpuram-uḍaiyār-kāḷam and Kalaimōr for a twilight lamp to the god Pālvaṇṇam-uḍaiyār.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift of one kalañju of gold by Kāḷi Kāḷi, a Kāvaṇamunri of Ravinallūr, for burning a twilight lamp to the same god in the temple at Paṭṭali.

cells.location: Arasan-palayam
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records the sale by the resident of Paṭṭali of a garden and an irrigation well to the temple treasury for twenty achchu of gold which was raised by a sale of cattle belonging to the temple for the temple.

cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the sale of land by assigning paddy recoverable from Karuḍyan-kauḷi alias Virāṭaḷa-chaturvēdimangalam in Virāṭaḷa-vaḷanāḍu, for the provision of daily offerings and worship to the god Palvaṇṇam-Uḍaiyār and the image of Nāchchiyār, his consort, which was set up in the name of Akkaḷin-Sōḷakulāmāṇikka-Muvaṇḍavēḷār figures as a signatory.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of gold for offerings at the service called Virarajendran-sandi. Kuladipa Muvendavelān Vanarāyadēva, Chedirāyadēva and Tyagavinoda are mentioned as signatories.

cells.location: Arasan-palayam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift of 40 achchu for offerings to god Palvannésvaram-Udaiyār. Mentions the measure Ponṇadu-nali.

cells.location: Arasan-palayam
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift of one kalañju of gold by Kuttan Iyalvallan Udīyasāingadēvan, a member of the Peruma-mudalis for a twilight lamp to the god.

cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift of money by Kuttan Valavandan of the Kavalan Kurumbillār of Patṭali to the residents of Nallār alias Amarabbuyankara-chaturvēdimangalam in Valuppukka-nadu for supplying paddy to the temple for the Sivaratri festival.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Records gift of two kalañju of gold by certain private individuals for two twilight lamps in the temple.

cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records gift of one kalañju of gold for a twilight lamp in the temple by the lady Solandi of Kadavr in Kāngaya-nadu.

cells.place: On the door-posts of the southern entrance into the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the erection of the mapdapa by Kuttan Kuttan alias Adiyamān, a member of the Kavalan-kurumpiljārs of Patṭali.

cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records gift of one kalañju of gold for a twilight lamp to the god by a private individual.

cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the same mapdapa.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Virantappallavaraiyan.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of gold for a twilight lamp by Sengatta[1], wife of Sōṇappallavaraiyan of Virakēralam.

cells.place: On the base of the east wall of the Maha-maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of gold for a twilight lamp by a private individual of the Kaṇalan-kuṟumpillai.

cells.place: On the base of the west wall of the Kōyil-bhāra shrine in Palvaṇḍa-varavaram temple. †
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold for a twilight lamp by the wife of a private individual.

cells.place: On a slab in a garden near Kōyil-bhāra shrine. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters and much damaged. Mentions Uttama Gāmiṇḍa Maṇṇidiyār.

cells.location: Kaṭṭaṅ-gaṇi
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the central shrine, in the Naṇṇal-vaṇṇavam temple
cells.date: Dhatu, Kanṇi, su. di., trayō-daśi, Friday, Śravapa.
cells.remarks: Records a deposit of gold with the temple priest by Viśva-mitraṇ Tirunarāyanapuratu-pilļai Jagannātha Brahmadārāyaṇ, a resident of Uđaiyapirāṭi-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Virerājendra-valanađu, a subdivision of Naraiyaṇ-ur-nađu for a twilight lamp to the god Nanmaniśvaram-Uđaiyar in the temple at Karṇayankāni alias Virāsōļa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Virasōļa-valanađu.

cells.place: Round the boss of Naṇṇal-vaṇṇavam temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land free of taxes to the temple. The gift is specifically mentioned at the end of the inscription as that of Virarājendradēva.

cells.location: Kaṭṭaṅ-gaṇi
cells.place: Round the boss of Naṇṇal-vaṇṇavam temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to record an order of Vīrapāṇḍyadēvaramāl granting a gift of land for rice offerings to the god and for five perpetual lamps.

cells.place: On the west wall of Naṇṇal-vaṇṇavam temple †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records gift of gold by Bharadvāji Ariyaporuļ Vinđuvarapperumaļ alias Vikrama-Pandya Brahmarāyar and his son Singaperumaļ Allaļanātha for offerings to the god on certain festival days.

cells.remarks: In modern characters. Records that during the regime of Nāyiṇāj Rāhuttaperumāḷ, son of Tribhuvanarājakkal Tambhirāyar-Parākramadēva, a gift of certain taxes was made to the temple. Vikramapāṇḍya Brahmā-rāya is mentioned as a signatory.

cells.place: Round the base of the Śōkapēru-mal temple in the same village (as Naṇṇal-vaṇṇavam temple). †
cells.remarks: Built in and incomplete. Seems to record gift of land, for offerings to the god Kulottuṅga-Cholavinnagar-aļvār. Brahmapallavarayar, Jayaṅgonda Mūvēndaveļaṇ and Virāsōļa-Mūvēndaveļaṇ figure as signatories.

cells.place: On the door-posts of the same shrine
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold by a private individual the interest from which was utilised for offerings to the god Kuḷōt-tuṅga-śōḷa-viṇṇagar-emberumān on certain days.

cells.place: On the door-posts of Śōkapēru-mal temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1630, [Sarva]-dhāri, Chittirai, 7, Monday, Hasa, daśami, Siṁha-lagna.
cells.remarks: Records that, while Vengi Aṅgiri-Nāyaka, the agent of Vengi-Minābhōi nayaka who was the agent of Śōkka-nātha, was holding court at Kaṅgayam, he presented 2 ma of land to the temple and left it under the supervision of Amudaiyā-Kōṇār-Kāḷatti-maṇḍiyār.

cells.location: Aratōḷuvu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 5 ma of land for offerings and worship to the god Tirunakkīśvaram-uḍaiyār at Ara-tōḷuvu in Kaṅgaya-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin †
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold by a private individual for a twelth lamp to the god.

cells.location: Aratōḷuvu
cells.place: On the wall of Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin †
cells.remarks: Records the erection of two door-posts in the central shrine of the temple by Kāvalan Puṇṇiyariyan Vīran.

cells.place: On the door-posts of the entrance into Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to the erection of two pillars in the ardia-maṇḍapa by a kavalan (name obliterated).

cells.place: On a slab in a field in front of Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Specifies that during the time of Vallarāya, the agent of Kṛishṇarāya, a lamp was granted to Aruḷāḷuva for offerings to the god and refers to the temple of Paḍi-chōṭu-avuḍaiyār at Madhavaram.

cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Tirunakkīśvara-svāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Refers to the building of the temple by a Brāhmaṇ.

cells.place: On the south wall of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Refers to the building of certain steps, etc., to the temple by a Gauḍan.

cells.location: Kaḍaiyūr
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Kōdaṇḍarāmasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the gift of one achchu of gold by a certain person for a twilight lamp to the god Aḷu-daivār Kāḍavar-Aṇḍār.

cells.place: On a slab in a field behind Kōdaṇḍarāmasvāmin temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1449, Kali 46, 28. Sarvajit, Vai-gaśi, 9, shashṭhi, Monday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Registers the assignment, by the residents (ūr) of Kaḍaiyūr by ūr, of a third of the yield of certain wet lands in Sīrukāḍavūr for offerings, etc., to the gods Kāḍavūr-appar and Paṇḍurē-appar.

cells.place: On a slab placed in front of a Vi-ṇayaka shrine in Kavundan-pāḷayam.
cells.remarks: Refers to a gift of 15 veļlam of dry land in Kaṇaiyur by Uttama Gaminda Maṇradiyar for the midday offerings to the god Sivanmalai-āṇdavar at Śivaṇ-malai.

cells.place: On a stone in the northern entrance into the Śiva temple of Mahāmaṇḍi on the island near Polavaram, Polavaram taluk, Godavari district.
cells.date: Śaka 133[0], Sarvadhari, Nija-Vai-śakha, śu. di, 15, Monday.
cells.remarks: Registers that Gōpīnātha Nīśankadēva-Mahārāja of Kōpala land from a Brāhmaṇ of Kopaka for the god Mahā-nandīśvara or Mahānandigiri-linga.

cells.place: On the stone of Śiva †
cells.date: Śaka 1330, Sarvadhari, Nija-Vai-śakha, śu. di, 51, Monday.
cells.remarks: Gives details of land in Kōpala purchased by Anna-dēvarāja, son of Chōḍa-bhaktirāja and granted to the temple of Mahānandigiri-linga and its sthānāpati Nīśankadēva.

cells.place: On a pillar at the southern entrance into the shrine of the Vīravīra temple at Paṭṭīsam, another island near Polavaram.
cells.remarks: States that the local and moffussil merchants granted certain tolls on pack-bullocks and buffaloes for providing daily oblations to the god Iṣṭakāmēśvara at Gaḍḍaram.

cells.place: On the pillar of Vīravīra †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Gift of land by Veṅkaṭavōlu to the temple of Iṣṭakāmēśvara at [Pa]ṭṭīsam, (for maintaining a perpetual lamp by a certain Lēṅka Ballaya-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Kaḍaiyūr
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: A certain Kosana Komana granted land for a lamp to the temple of Ishṭakamīsvara-Mahadēva.

cells.place: On a pillar at the southern entrance of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Records some grants of land and mentions Rajala-Mahadēvi, queen of Malayamu Mahadēvarāja. The village Dēvami is also mentioned.

cells.location: Kaḍaiyūr
cells.place: On a pillar at the southern entrance of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers that Aṇapa Mavena-Perggaṇa, minister of the king granted land at various places to the god Ishṭakamīsvara.

cells.place: On a pillar at the southern entrance of Vīravīra temple. †
cells.remarks: Grant of land by Aṇḍāḷamma Pimmieṭṭi for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple of Iṣṭakāmēśvara at Guṇṭūru for the merit of the parents.

cells.place: On the pillar of Vīravīra ... †
cells.remarks: Gift by the Lady Prōma to the god Iṣṭakāmēśvara.

cells.place: On a pillar in the ardha-maṇḍapa of Vīravīra temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Eulogy of the god Bhīmēśvara of Sūryanārayaṇapuram.

cells.place: On the pillar of Vīravīra ... †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of 5 gold madas by the lady Anyama. Also records grants of land to Bhimanāthadēva of Gunṭāla by several persons.

cells.place: On another pillar in the place of Vīravīra †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Provides for the various items of worship and oblations on the three periods of the day.

cells.place: On two pillars to the south of the Alvār-shrine behind the sanctum of Śrī-Rāma temple at Bhadrāchalam Bhadrāchalam taluk, Godāvari district.
cells.date: Śaka 1754, Nandana, Chaitra, śu. di., 9, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Registers that a certain Varada-Ramadāsu of Kaḷichi-nagara, who was an incarnation of Śrī-Rāmadāsu of the time of Tanisha, came to Bhadrāchalam and spent his time there as a devotee. He constructed the temple and performed the daily worship of the Haṣanachā-Paragu (in His Exalted Highness the Nizam's State) in the time of Nawab Nāsiruddauḷa and conferred a large part of the income of that Paragana on the temple and the Brahmins who were connected with it. Numerous other details concerning the establishment, festivals, worship, oblations, etc., of the temple are also registered.

cells.place: On a mutilated pillar lying near the mirror-chamber in the temple of Alvār. †
cells.date: Śaka 1546, Raltak-shi, Phalguna, śu. di., 5, Thuraday.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that a certain lady devotee of Raghunāyaka of Bhadrachalam, the wife of Mutyam Akkamappa, a Padmanāyaka born in the Vipparla-gōtra caused the mukha-mandapa and the prākara to be built as her charity in the temple and gave the whole of the village of Gundālu for providing festivals and servants. Another part of the inscription records that a daughter of Mutyala Rāmaṭka, named Appalamma, built and consecrated the shrine of Nammaļvār ; and her daughter, a certain Akkam . . . built the bhōga-mandapa for Raghunāyaka.

cells.location: Mailavaram, Ongole taluk, Guṇṭūr district
cells.place: On a slab set up near the old villagesite
cells.remarks: Records that the village-chavadi (racchayillu), tanks, and temple are of (i.e. constructed by f) Gujapotheri. His elder son died in the battle of Nidumānu (the present Nidumānūr near Ongole). The Raṭṭadi (i.e., the Reddi of Nidumānūr) gave two kaṇduga of field land ? (arlapatṭu) to brahmans.

cells.location: Muḍunuru, Gannavaram Kistna district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a Nandi-pillar set up in front of the Rāmalingasvāmi temple
cells.remarks: Contains a long eulogy of the Purpaya family stating that during their connection with the Kaḷattūyus, the end are given the names of the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kōmaṇḍravāḍi Bhīmarāja and his two sons Chōḍayarāja and Pōtarāja.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On a pillar in the Svarṇēśvara-temple
cells.remarks: Gift of 30 cows for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple of Svarnēśvara at Padminipura.

cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of 50 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Svarṇēśvara at Padminīpura.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of 50 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Svarṇēśvara at Padminīpura.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kolani-maṇḍalīka Maṅgayadēvarāja, his servant Eṇumadala Aṇuma-Nāyaka and the latter's son Kuḍama-Nāyaka.

cells.place: On another pillar in the temple of Svarṇēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Stated that the pillar was built by Siddh(ja)bhari, son of Ēṣachāri Maṇḍalāchāri.

cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of 50 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Svarṇēśvara at Padminīpura.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Registers a gift of 150 sheep for three perpetual lamps evidently in the temple of Svarṇēśvara, at Padminīpura.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Do. Records a gift of sheep for perpetual lamps.

cells.location: Guṇapāvaram, Bhīmavaram taluk, Sāme district
cells.place: On the pillar of Svarṇēśvara .. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land for worship and services in the temple of Svarṇēśvara at Padminīpura.

Records the tax-free grant of the village Hiṇḍuvaka in the Puṇyakīrti-Pañchali-viṣhaya, by the king, to his guru Patanga-Śivācharya for guru-pūjā. The latter gave half of the village to (the god) Yogeśvaradeva.

cells.date: 204th year of reign, Mārggaśīrṣha, māsa, śukla, trayodaśī.
cells.remarks: States that the king made a tax-free gift of the village Tallabhūra in Krōuṣhṭuka-varttanī to the venerable scholar Viṣhṇu-Sōmacharya of the Pārṇāru-gotra residing at Śrīngātikā-agrahāra in the Kāmarūpa-viṣhaya. The grant was made on the occasion of his father's coronation, at the request of the brother Jaya-varman.
Records the tax-free gift of the village Koṇḍoḍu in the Kṇiṅgikhāru-viṣhaya to the Agnihōtri and Bhaṭṭa Gōndēvasvāmi of the Kauśika-gotra and Viṣhṇasōnavarman.

Registers the grant by the king of the villages Krishnāpuru, K[i]nna-Pōsalapāḍu, -Pedda-Pōsalapāḍu, Śikesāla and Veṇnūlappāḍu with the village Daṇḍanayaka-cheruvu surnamed Krishnarāyasamudram, to a large number of Brahmans on the occasion of the gift of Krishnāpuru to the dēvasthāna. The village belonged to the 'Eḍapti'-sīma of the Guṭi-rājya.

A clear forgery. Presumes to register the several ayagāras (incumbents) like reddi, karanam, purohita, etc., for the villages of Potṭipadu and Kavulūru in the Gutti-durga founded by some private individuals. Reference is made to a certain Sambhaṭi Tipparaju.

Characters are too late for the date given. Also a forgery. Gives the lands assigned to the sevbral services attached to the village Tarimela in the Gutti-rājya. Lands attached to the local temples of Chennakeśvara and īsvara are also mentioned.

cells.date: Śaka 1377, mistake for 1477, Rakshasa, Srāvana śu. 5.
cells.remarks: Purports to be an agrahāra-śāsana (gift-deed) granted by the king in respect of the village Neṭeṇallu, while camping near it on his way to Guṭi, being told that god Hanuman was manifest (jāgrata) there.

Like No. 5 above is a forgery of the same date giving the several āyagāras for the three villages Koṅganapalle, Śaṅkarabaṇḍa and Mulukalapeṇṭa, which were founded by certain private individuals and mentions the same chief Sambhaṭi Tipparāju.

Registers the grant, of the post of reḍḍi with lands attached to it, to a certain Kōṭireḍḍi Narapareḍḍi in respect of the village Dēvarapalle in the Gutti-rājya known as Bhāskara-kshētra (i. e., seat of the Sun).

cells.king: Prauḍhadēvarāya †
cells.date: Śaka 1344, Vijaya (wrong), Kārtika, śu. 10 †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Narrates in detail the troubles undergone by a Nayaka who owned the village Patakotta-cheruvu in the matter of making good the loss of merchandise sustained by certain merchants while in transit, in the vicinity of the village. The incident is referred to the time of the occupation of the Kernaṭaku and the Gutti fort by the Nawab of Golkonda on behalf of the Pachchhayi (i.e., the Mughal Emperor of Delhi). At its commencement the record quotes the date Saka 1834, Vijaya (wrong), Kartika, sū. 10 and refers to the Vijayanagara king Praudhadevarāya.

Incomplete. Plates 2 and 4 are missing. Registers the sarvamānya grant of some double-crop (dvisāra) land in the village Chembala lying in the Rāyadurga-veṇṭe (i.e., province) and Uruvakoṇḍa-sīma for the benefit of the temple of Chennakēśava built on the east side of the village.

Registers the grant of the village Velicherla in the Jaladaṅki-sthala of the Paṅkanāṭi-sīma to the east of the Udayāchala (i.e., Udayagiri)-durga, by the king who was ruling at Uṇḍrakoṇḍa, to the Brahman Koṇḍaya of the Bhāradvāja-gōtra and Yajuś-śākhā. The donee was a resident of the village Pulugulla.

cells.date: Śaka 1012 (wrong), Krōdhana, Vaiyāśi, 21, ba., pañchamī, Monday, Śravaṇa.
cells.remarks: States that a family of seven gauṇḍas, which hailed from Vēlūr-śīrmai on the northern bank of the Pālār river in Āyinda-nāḍu, a sub-division of Paḻuvūr-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Toṇḍamaṇḍalam and which settled down near Vēlūr having founded the village of Lattēri by clearing the forest, succeeded in repulsing the attack of a band of 500 freebooters who came from the north and that as a reward for this act of heroism Abarangbeg-Pasha conferred on the gauṇḍas the headmanship (?) (gauḍikai) of the village of Lattēri with right to collect one kalam of grain on every kāṇi of certain lands specified therein. The record seems to be a forgery.

cells.date: Śaka 1680, Kali 4862, Primadi, Tai 21, Uttarayana, Thursday, Pushya.
cells.remarks: Registers that Savayi Vijayaraghunatha Gopalar, son of Savayi Vijayaraghunatha Kinamettanan Gopalar, who was the chief of Sirunellikkottai in Pamba-valanadu, a sub-division of Rajendraśoja-valanadu in Rajaganbhira-valanadu, a district of Rajaraja-valanadu, gave 46 poñ of gold to the temple Jayangondanathasvamin in Pambanadu for the evening service of the god therein. Another record dated in Śaka 1690, Kali 4860, Ivara, Vaigaśi, 2, is engraved in continuation of the above on the same plate and registers a gift of 45 Rajagopalanchakram-poñ of gold by the inhabitants of the sixteen divisions between the western and eastern boundaries of Pappakkudi-nadu, a sub-division of Poyyur-kūgram, a district of Jayangondanadu, for the midday service of the god, Jayangondanathasvamin consecrated in a temple which was newly erected after clearing some fruit-gardens.

cells.date: Śaka 1680, Kali, 4861, Bahudhanya, Āpi. 16, Uttarayana, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records a further gift of 91 poñ and 2 panam by the individual mentioned in No. 14 above for conducting a service called Kolahala-sandi in the same temple. The poñ (gold coin) is called Rajagopalachakram. cells.place: On a stone lying near the flight of steps at the southern door-way of Nrisimha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that the dēvōdabagilu (the narrow gateway) on the south was constructed by a certain Jaginayaka for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Penna-hoblium † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab built into the northern wall of the maṇdapa of the inner shrine of Nrisimha-svāmi temple. †
cells.language: Sanskrit and Telugu in very modern characters.
cells.remarks: States that a certain Veņka[ja]dri-Nayaka paid respects to the god. He is said to have belonged to the family of Prabhasa (two, [? Valmiki]), the author of the Ramakatha of Jareyuru.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Penna-hoblium † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a third slab set up in Nrisimha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of land made by Bommya-Nayaka, an officer of Anantarasa-Vodēya, the chief minister of Vira-Bukkardya, for offerings to the god Ramāyadeva at the village of Jareyuru.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Penna-hoblium † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in Rāmēsvara temple, †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Jarivūṭu in the Penna-magani attached to Jagatapi Gutti, to the god Ramēsvara of the village, by the Mahanāyakachārya, Kēsama-Nayaka with the permission of the king and of Narasa-Nayaka.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Penna-hoblium † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying by the side of the approach to Rāmēsvara temple, †
cells.remarks: Damaged; states tijat the sorvioe rendered to the god Ramāyadeva by Sivarāmaya, a disciple of Siddāyadeva of Kollapura should not be hindered,

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Narimēṭla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Āñjanēya temple
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Narimēṭla in the Uravala-koṇḍa-sīma to 6 nambi-s of the temple of Panna-Aṅvhaladēva for offerings and lamps to the god, by an officer of Pemmasāni Timma-Nāyaka.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Narimēṭla † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Rāmēsvara. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to mention Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Ramaraju [Tirumala]...-arasa. Registers an agreement for the cultivation of lands of the village Narimēṭla granted to (certain) nambi-s of the temple by the people of the pārupatyagāra (manager) of Varuvakoṇḍa.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the Āñjanēya temple
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement similar to the above granted to the officers and the people of the village Paltūru by Sōmaṇa-Nāyaka, the agent of Chapparada Kōṇappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field near Rāmēsvara temple. †
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 6, Durnmukhi, Margasīrṣa, ba., 13, Monday.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Mentions Nāgahalli and Koṇḍi-yaṇa-nāyu.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another stone lying in the same field, Rāmēsvara temple. †
cells.date: Chāgadēva's year Rākṣasa, Chait-ra, amāvāsyā, Monday.
cells.remarks: Records the death of some persons in a cattle raid at the village Paltūru.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field to the north-west of the same village (as Rāmēsvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land to a certain Banlupa, a māṣah of the village Pālūru by Pemmasāni Timma-Nāyaka.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the Vīrabhadra temple in the same village (as Rāmēsvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Refers to the re-employment of the pūjāris of the god Vīrabhadra at Baṛūlu by an officer of Kōṇappa-Nāyaka exempting them from the payment of certain taxes formerly levied from them by the chief.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Palturu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field to the north-east of Karakamak-ki.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift of land made by a certain Malli-Nāyaka for the offerings to the god Molasthāna Mahākālēśvara at Karakamaṇḍi.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Hāva-liġi — Andhra Pradesh

cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 4, Sī [li]dhar-thi, Puṣpaya, amāvāsyā, Thursday, Uttarāyaṇa-Sam-krānti.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land, a garden and an oil-mill to the priest (āchārya) of the temple of the god Pañchaliṅga-Siddhēśvaradēva by the Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Maṅgarasa 'the lord [of] Orya yarpara,' who was ruling over the Maṭi 300 and Kappanallu 300 districts.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Hāva-liġi † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Registers a gift of land free of taxes (sarvamanya) to the brāhmaṇas of the agrahāra village Hambaligi under the orders of the Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Iruṅgola-Mahārāja.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Hāva-liġi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field two miles to the north of the same village (as temple of Channakēśava). †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to a certain Chintāmaṇi-Ayyavāru for conducting certain services in the temple of Kapilēśvara-dēva at Pampakahōra by the Dēśāhi of Uravakoṇḍa and the Reddi and Karaṇam of the village Habhige.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Hāva-liġi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field to the east of the same village (as temple of Channakēśava). †
cells.remarks: Mentions Hābaḷige. Records a grant of land as puli-mānya to a certain Butsayya by the Dēsāhi of Urōkoṇḍa and the Reḍḍi and Karaṇam of Hāmbaḷige.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Hāva-liġi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a broken hero-stone lying in a field south of the same village (as temple of Channakēśava). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. States that Kundamaṉ, a relative of the king, made an attack (and probably died) while the king (name lost) was capturing the Chiriyāḷa fort.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Vidapanakallu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Vīrabhadra temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to regulate certain taxes due from the village Viḍupanakallu.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Velpumadugu — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Damaged. States that the mukha-maṇḍapa in the temple of Channakēśavasvāmi at Vēlpumaḍugu was constructed by some members of the Nandavarika community.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Koṇḍakoṇḍu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field near Kandispalli.
cells.remarks: Beginning lost. Records a grant of the village Kaṇḍala-haḷḷi for daily offerings, festivals, satra-Brāhmaṇu and servants of the temple of Bhōgēśvaradēva at Haṭṭha-lige.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Appajipēṭa — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land in the village Kallūruvātu made by the Mahāmandalēśvara Peda Singarājayyadēva Maharaja, grandson of Kandanavoli Rāmaraja and son of Mūrtirāja to the temples of Rāmēśvara on the hill and in the village.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Bamgiri — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone behind the tank-bund
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer a gift of land.

cells.location: Saluvūr, Vāndavāsi taluk, North Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Maṇikuḷam-uḍaiyāra temple
cells.remarks: Records gift of the village of Murukkēri in Sājukkuppāṛṛu as a tax-free dēvadāna to the temple of Aḷudaiyār Māṇi-kuḷamuḍaiyār-Uḍaiyār for worship and repairs.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Īśvara temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1440, Īśvara, Mithuna, śu., pañchamī, Monday, Śravaṇa.
cells.remarks: Records the remission of a tax (śōḍi) of 20 poṉ and the transfer, as sarvamānya, of the two temples of Uḍaiyār Manukulamādīśvaram-uḍaiya-Nayiṉār and Perumāḷ Śōḻakēraḷaviṇṇagaram-Emberumāṉār of Śaḷukki alias Śōḻakēraḷam from the administrative control of Vandavāśi-sīrmai to that of Vīrabhadrarāyar-sīrmai, for purposes of the expenses connected with offerings, worship and festivals in these temples.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Īśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "[Tamil script]," etc. Registers the sale as dēvadāna of two vēli of land by the merchant-guild (nagarattār) of Śōḻakēraḷapuram, a city in Veṅkuṉṟa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Veṅkuṉṟa-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam, to Sundari Udayañjeydāḷ alias Pūvēndiyaśōḷa-māṇikkam, a dancing-girl attached to the temple of Manukulakēsari-Īśvaram-Uḍaiyār, for setting up the image of Tiruppaḷḷiyaṟai-nambiraṭṭiyār and for offerings to and for burning a perpetual lamp before the image.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Registers gift of gold by a private individual for burning two twilight lamps in the temple and for offerings to the god during new-moon days.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Īśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record the order of Śambuvarāya remitting certain taxes on certain lands in Śaḷukkipaṟṟu for the expenses connected with offerings, worship and burning perpetual lamps in the temple of Uḍaiyār Manukulakēsarīśvaram-uḍaiya-Nayiṉār.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the introduction, "[Tamil script]," etc. Seems to register a sale of land. The city (nagaram) of Śaḷukki alias Śōḻakēraḷapuram was situated in Veṅkuṉṟa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Veṅkuṉṟa-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the east wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Mentions that as the weavers of Śaḷukki were unable to pay the various minor taxes and had left the village, these taxes were consolidated into a lump-sum tax on each loom, with provision for remission where looms were not working, etc., so as to induce the weavers to recolonise the village.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Īśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction, "[Tamil script]," etc., and also mentions the third year of the king, 'who having taken Kalyāṇapuram and Kolhāpuram died on the elephant's back.'

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west walls of Īśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Begins with the introduction, "[Tamil script]," etc. Records a gift of land by the merchants (nagarattār) of Śōḻakēraḷapuram by purchase from the temple treasury of Manukula-Mahādēva for the conduct of street-processions on Sundays and for providing offerings and a perpetual lamp to the god in the temple.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Singanārāyaṇa-Perumal temple in the same village (as Īśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: States that Pendai-Muṟaṭpuli of Veṅkuṉṟa-kōṭṭam consecrated the images of Śōḷakēraḷa-viṇṇagar-Emberumāṉ of the western temple, Manukulamādēvīśvaram-Uḍaiyār of Śrīkayilāyam (temple), Vīrakēraḷapperumbaḷḷi and Uttaradēvī as a protection of the city (Saḷukki) and made provision for worship, offerings, lamps and flower-gardens in the first two temples mentioned above and also made gifts of land to all the temples by assigning the villages of Erumbūr, Kurumbūr, Vīraperumbākkam and Iluppai. The servants required for these temples were also given house-sites.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the maṇḍapa in front of Singanārāyaṇa-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Records gifts of certain taxes to the temple for conducting a service called Kōdaṇḍarāman-śandi in the name of the king and for offerings and worship to the god, Nāyaṉār Śōḷakēraḷa-viṇṇagar-Emberumāṉ and for repairs to the temple.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Singanārāyaṇa-Perumal temple. †
cells.date: 40th year, Makara, ba., daśamī, Thursday, Anushā.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the tax-free gift of certain lands in the hamlets of this village as kuḍiniṅgāda-tiruviḍaiyāṭṭam to the god Śōḷakēraḷa-Emberumāṉ by the residents of Saḷukki alias Śōḷakēraḷapuram.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Singanārāyaṇa-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Mentions that Puttuḷan Āḷuḍaiyāṉ Kāmaṉ Vaśiravaṇaṉ built the maṇḍapa, the sōpāna (flight of steps) and the stone-gateway of the temple of Śōḷakēraḷa-viṇṇagar-Emberumāṉ and covered them with plaster.

cells.location: Salukkai, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of Singanārāyaṇa-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: States that Vijayapālaṉ of Puduppākkam made an ornamental pedestal and had the god installed on it.

cells.location: Desur, Wandiwash taluk, North Arcot district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: In modern characters. Mentions that the door posts of stone were the gift of Veṅgappa-Nāyaka, son of Muḍiyaḍi Nāgappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Singaperumalkoyil, Chingleput taluk and district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to refer to some gift made by a private individual .... Ayyaṟa-Nakkaṉ for offerings to the god Narasiṅga-viṇṇagar-Āḻvār of Seṅguṉṟam in .... kuṉṟa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kaḷattūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Built in to the stone flooring. Refers to Vagīśvaradēva belonging to the Kīlaimada-santanam in Sellatīruvarār and residing in Perumbarrappuliyūr (Chidambaram), to whom some gift seems to have been made by a nātive of Puļal. Records a tax-free gift (sarvamānya) of 5,000 kuli of land by the residents of Puļal for the maintenance of a maṭha, to Tirukkadavār-Mudaliyar.

cells.location: Pulal, Saidapet taluk, Chingleput district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the outer base of the east wall of the mandapa in front of Tirumūlanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records gift of oil derivable from one oil-mill to the god Tirumūlasthānam-uḍaiya-Nāyiṉār, for the merit of Guruvarājayya and the residents of Puḻal.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the outer base of the east wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers the assignment to certain individuals of the charge of the temple lamps (tiruviḷakku-maṉṟāḍi) of Uḍaiyār Tirumūlasthānam-Uḍaiya-Nāyaṉār of Puḻal alias Rāyasundarinallūr in Puḻal-nāḍu, a subdivision of Puḻal-kōṭṭam alias Vikramaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: Pulal, Saidapet taluk, Chingleput district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records gift of oil derivable from one oil-mill to the god Tirumūlasthānam-uḍaiya-Nāyiṉār, for the merit of Guruvarājayya and the residents of Puḻal.

cells.location: Pulal, Saidapet taluk, Chingleput district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records gift of .... svamandala-śirmai of the two villages of Muṉṉainallūr and Attippaṭṭu in Puḻal-śīrmai to Pirandūr, Nayiṉār of Gōvindapuram and of the Mudgala-gōtra by Taḻuvakkuḻaindāṉ-Bhaṭṭar of Conjeeveram for the merit of Śellappa Sāḷuva-Daṇḍanāyakar for conducting the festivals of the god Tirumūlasthānam-uḍaiya-Nāyaṉār of Puḻal.

cells.remarks: Refers to a gift of fifty kuḻi of land by Piḷaiporuttār-Piḷḷai, for certain offerings to the god during nights in addition to that previously granted by Kaḷattinātha-Mudaliyār of Vallaippākkam and the residents of Puḻal for the day offerings.

cells.location: Kottapalli, Dindigul taluk, Madura district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the door-jambs of the entrance into the Ammaṉ shrine in the Narasiṁhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records that the Ammaṉ temple was repaired during the time of Śiṉṉa-Kadira Nāyakkaṉ, Raṅga-Deṇṇāyakkaṉ and the latter's son Narasiṅga-Nāyakkaṉ, when they were headmen of the village.

cells.location: Kot-tapalli, Dindigul taluk, Madura district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the Alvar shrine in Amman shrine. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction, "pūviṉ kiḻatti," etc. Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of land.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Inside the same shrine
cells.remarks: Records that the Āḻvār temple was built by Periyaṇa-Piḷḷai, son of Vīraṇa-Piḷḷai.

cells.location: Punnam, Karur taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the maṇḍapa in front of the Pushpavananāthēśvara temple

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: In the same maṇḍapa right of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of dry land by the residents of Puṉṉam to a stone-mason for having chiselled a stone lamp-pillar for the temple of Puṟpavaṉam-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: Punnam, Karur taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the same maṇḍapa right of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land as dēvadāna by the residents of Puṉṉam for offerings twice a day to the god, Āḷuḍaiya-Tambirāṉār Puṟpavaṉam-uḍaiya-Nāyaṉār at that village.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Inside the kitchen in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Seems to record gifts of money and land to the god by Kappudal Vāṇḍināyanar, one of the fishermen (i.e. padavar) of Pañjan on his return from Conjeeveram.

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the introduction "பூமலி வளர" etc. Mentions the temple of Tiruvirumbōlai-Uḍaiyār in Jananātha-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmādēya in Muḍikoṇḍachōla-vaḷanāḍu, a subdivision of Surattūr-nāḍu. Begins with the introduction "பூமலி வளர" etc.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the above. Records gift of 3 kasu by a private individual of Patṭam in Ārūr-kūṇram, a subdivision of Nittavinōda-valanādu for a twilight lamp to the god.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Apatsahāyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "பூமலி வளர" etc. Records gift of land by Tiruchirrambala-Uḍaiyān of Karuppūr in Marug-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayamkoṇḍa-chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu for perpetual lamp to the god Tiruvirumbōlai-Uḍaiyār and Vinayaka-Piḷḷaiyār.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Apatsahāyēśvara †

cells.remarks: Records the assignment, free of taxes, of certain lands in the village of (Tiruvirumbōlai for the maintenance of a matha of Yajñanāya-Mudaliār.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Apatsahāyēśvara †

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
