cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the same prākāra; left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction, "[Tamil script]", etc. Records gift of paddy by a dancing girl for a perpetual lamp to the temple of Tiruvirumbūḷai-Uḍaiyār at Jananātha-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu

cells.place: On the east wall of the same prākāra; left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction, "[Tamil script]" etc. Records gift of land by Vāṇadarāya alias Rājēndra-Koṟṟamaṅgalam-Nāḍāḻvān for constructing with stone the second prākāra of the temple and for offerings to the god.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the prākāra; left of entrance.

cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "pū-maḍantai" &c. Records gift of 12 kāśu by a resident of Tiruvārūr alias Rāja-māṇikka-Muṇaiyadaraiyar of Viṇṇamangalam in Kuḍa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Miṉṉai-kūṟṟam, a district of Jayangoṇḍa-chōḷamaṇḍalam, for a perpetual lamp.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Apatsahāyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "pū-maḍantai" &c. Records gift of 12 kāśu by a resident of Vaṇṇiyūr in Veṇṇai-kūṟṟam for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: Alangudi, Pāpanāsam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Apatsahāyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "pū-maḍantai" &c. Records gift of certain tax-free lands in lieu of certain exchanges of gold belonging to the temple which were appropriated on two former occasions, viz., when Vijayarājēndra ordered, while camping in Vōṅgu-maṇḍalam, a tax of one kaḻañju of gold on every vēli of land and also when in a period of drought, the temple authorities had to improve existing irrigation. Gives also the details of a gift in the third year of Udayar Vikrama-Chōḷadēva, viz. Makara, śu. śaturdaśi, Saturday, Śatabhishaj. The village assembly met in the hall (sabhā-śālai) called Sambiyapāṇḍavi.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Amritalur — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rough stone set up in a street
cells.remarks: Registers the agreement (Kaula) granted by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chinna-Timma-Rāja to the people that the settlement at the Amrita (market village) built by him to the south of Amritalur in the name of Mahāmandirāja. No taxes were payable by the settlers in the pēṭa for the first three years. After that period they were required to pay taxes on ploughs, looms, and houses, big and small. States that Nāgappa-Nāyaka the agent (karyakarta) of the King gave an agreement to the merchants, weavers, etc., of Siripuram to pay for three years, taxes on account of a plunder suffered by the people. Refers to Śrīraṅgapaṭaya who was evidently ruling then.

cells.remarks: Registers that the king constructed a Śiva temple and set up the god Chōḍa-Mallēśvara in the name of his younger brother for the merit of his father Udayādityadēva Chōḍa-Mahārāja and his mother Kamalādēvi.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Chundūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the stone of Vaguṇōpalasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers the lands in Chundūru granted to the god) Pāṇḍēva and a number of Brahmans by Mahārāya Gajapati Mamma Gannapa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Chundūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the Nandi-pillar lying before the Papēśvara temple in the same village (as temple of Vaguṇōpalasvāmin). †
cells.date: Śaka 1690, Sarvajit, Kārtika, Brihas-pati in Kanya.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Contains the praises of the god Śiva worshipped at the confluence of the Tungabhadrā and Kshiranadi. Refers to a Brahman named Rudra.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Davulūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the black granite pillar set up before the Gokarṇēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers that the king who was the son of Mahâmanđalésvara Velanânti Rajendra-Chođa Gangéyarâya gave to Kommaya-Nayaka, the son of Âytama-Nayaka, the Rađdikam, i.e., the office of rađdi of Davuluru and that Kommaya-Nayaka set up the god Gökésvara with Pârvati in the village and presented three puṭṭis of land to the temple and 55 sheep for a perpetual lamp. Grants of lands made to the dancing girls, drummer, etc., of the temple are also recorded.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Davulūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the pillar of Gokarṇēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the king Rajendra-Chođa and states that Kommaya-Nayaka built the Chandésa-manđapa of the Šiva temple of Gökésvara built by him already.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Davulūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers that Aytamambika presented 55 sheep for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple of Gökésvara at Davuluru. She was the wife of Âytama-Nayaka who was the favourite servant of Velanânti Rajendra-Chođa and the rađdi of the villages Kurungallu and Davuluru.

cells.king: Rajadhiraja Mâbaraja Šri Maha[mandu] Kolli Ku. .. . Šaha.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers grants of lands in the village Chamarlamuṇḍi (Jagarlamuṇḍi) and Kolunkūru. The names of the donor and the donee are lost. Mentions Miriṭijamārgam (i.e., Kondavīḍu).

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another stone lying in the same temple.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kathēvaram — Andhra Pradesh

cells.place: On the outer south wall of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple
cells.date: Šaka 1240, Kalayukti, Aśvayuja, šu., 14, Monday. Do.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land made by Poṭṭuṇṭakuṇṭi, son of the commander-in-chief Sōmaya-lēṅka for the Saturday offerings of the god Kōśvara at Kolakulūru.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up before the temple Agastyēśvarasvāmin in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land made by the king for the Monday offerings (dharmadāna), and flowers of the god Agastyēśvara at Kolakulūru.

cells.place: On a stone set up before the temple Agastyēśvarasvāmin in the same village (as Chennakēśavasvāmin temple). †

cells.place: On a Nandi-pillar lying before the Ramachodésvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers that Surapa-Nāyaka, the lord of Moḍukūru, who was the servant of the Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Chōḍadēva, who was the pillar to the kingdom of the Chālukya, erected the Nandi-pillar and the temple in the name of his maternal uncle and made the necessary provisions by giving land for offerings and for servants and giving the necessary utensils to the temple.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Modukuru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the temple of Virabhadra
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers that a Sūdra named Lāḍigaya-bhaṭṭa established the goddess Bhadra-Kālī in the temple of Vīrabhadra at Modukuru on the banks of the Tuṅgabhadra stream.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Moparru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar lying before the Choḍeśvarasvāmin temple
cells.king: Kuḷottuṅga Rājendra-Choḍayārāja †
cells.remarks: Records that Guḍhaya, the commander (daṇḍanātha) of Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara Kuḷottuṅga Rājendra-Choḍayārāja constructed the temple of Choḍeśvara at Moparru for the merit of his father Choḍaya-Nāyaka and his mother Nāyāsāni. He also presented 110 sheep for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple. Also registers the grant of 55 sheep for the same temple by Gōkāsāni for the merit of her husband Goṅki-Nāyaka and the grant of some land for the daily offerings of the god.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Moparru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the pillar of Choḍeśvarasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers that the chief Goṅka and his wife Gōkāmbika granted to the god Śaṅkara of Moparru two perpetual lamps and one perpetual lamp respectively. At the beginning is given the genealogy of the Choḍa family. Choḍa was the servant of Velanāṇḍu Goṅka and governed the Shaṭasahasra (six thousand, i.e., Aṇvōlu) country and Veṅgī. Gives the names of the dancing girls appointed to serve in the same temple.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Moparru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the southern side of the eastern gateway of Choḍeśvarasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Defines in a ślōka the length of the linear measures of aṅgula, vitasti and daṇḍa and states the circumference of the thumb in an aṅgula. Twelve aṅgulas make one vitasti and thirty-two vitastis make one daṇḍa. In the Telugu portion the kesaripāṭi-ghaḍa which corresponds to the daṇḍa is mentioned. A vertical line is cut over the inscription to give the exact measurement, evidently, of the vitasti. It measures a little over 1 foot and 3 inches.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Mulpuru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone built into the north wall of the Chennakēśava temple
cells.remarks: Registers the gifts of lands made in several villages by Vallaya-Nāyaka a bodyguard (aṅgarakshaka) of the king, for offerings and lamps to the god Kīli-Kēśavadeva.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Peravali — Andhra Pradesh

She was the daughter of Nidumūri Kommaya and Mallāmbika. Some land was granted by son the general (daṇḍādha) Choḍa to the god to the priest Mādhav-Bhaṭṭa.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Peravali † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone built into the roof of Mādhavasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: The record narrates the philanthropic acts (of a chief whose name is lost) among which was the foundation of a feeding-house (satra śāla) and a temple. He was the son of Mallāmbā. A certain Paḍleya-Nāyaka is mentioned and a gift of sheep is also recorded.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Tenali — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the eastern side of the southern entrance to the Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of jewels to the godis Gōpinātha and Gōvardhanarāya by Dēvana Nāyareḍḍi.

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions (the god) Gōpinātha.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Tenali † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up before the Gōvardhanasvāmin temple at the same village (as Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple). †
cells.dynasty: Vijayanagara †
cells.king: Kṛishṇarāya †
cells.date: Śaka 1411, Saumya, Vaiśākha, Śukla-paksha, Haridina (i.e. ēkādaśī).
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gives a descriptive praise of the (god) Gōvardhanēśa, who appeared in the form of a cowherd to his devotee Vallabha, quoting the famous verse in the Bhagavad-Gītā, which ends with "Dharmasaṁsthāpanāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge". Says also that the god became manifest (i.e., was installed) and was named Gōvardhanēśa. No date quoted. The Vijayanagara king Kṛishṇarāya and his minister Sāḷuva Timmaraśu are said to have visited the temple and made gifts to it.

cells.place: On the east wall of Iśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of lamp.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the east and north walls of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "திருமன்னி வளர, etc.". Records a gift of 20 kaḻañju of gold by a private individual for two perpetual lamps to the temple of Jayangoṇḍaśōḷīśvaram. Mentions the liquid measure Aruṃoḷidēvan.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction "திருமன்னி வளர, etc.". Registers a gift of land, free of taxes, to the Jayangoṇḍaśōḷīśvara temple (built by the merchants Viḻkkūr alias Jayangoṇḍaśōḷapuram in Aṇḍināḍu, a district of Peṟumpaṉappāḍi in Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷamaṇḍalam). The details of expenditure for the temple are also noted.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone near the Kaḷa-Bhairava-bhāra temple near the Railway station at Vaḷattūr
cells.remarks: Mentions a certain Nuḷambarāyaṉ of Aṟumbākkam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kuḷidikki — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone near the river
cells.remarks: Records the death of Gaṇḍayārasar Kaṇadru Peṟuṅgaṅgar, chief of Kāṟkāṭṭūr at the instance of the uncle or father-in-law (māmaḍi) of the Bāṇa king fought and fell on the day of the Puḷava invasion against Peṟuṅga-ṇadigaḷ (i.e., the king) and the destruction of Paṅkuḷik-koṭṭai.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Seṅkunram † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the rock of the Prasanna-Veṅkaṭēśvarasvāmin temple at Seruvalpalli (Toṭṭioral-mottur).
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Kumigili Bayyappa had the images consecrated.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kōva-nur — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the Kaiḷā-nathasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records a sale of 1,000 kuḻi of land near the tank by the assembly of Kavaṇūr in Mīyāṟu-nāḍu to Vayiyāmō-ghan alias Toṟuvatti-Peṟuntattan, and the gift of the same for the maintenance of the tank. Mentions the measuring rod Kaḍigai kaḷaṭṭu-kōl.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kēvanur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west wall of Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a sale of land by the assembly of Kavaṇūr.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kēvanur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 400 kuḻi of land near the tank by one of the members of the assembly for a perpetual lamp to the god Puḷibhagavadēva.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kēvanur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north and west walls of Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning and at the end. Seems to register a mortgage (vīṭṭu-vīracha) by the assembly of Kavaṇūr in Mīyāṟu-nāḍu. The record appears to lay down that the seller and the purchaser and the mortgagor and the mortgagee of lands must be of the same community.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kēvanur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Refers to a gift of 400 kuli of waste land which had to be reclaimed and made arable by the assembly of Kavaṇur to provide for daily night-offerings to Pulibhagavadēva. Mentions the measuring rod ‘ Kadigaikalattukkōl.’ Refers also to another gift of 800 kuli of land which had to be brought under cultivation for maintaining lamps at the three services of the god and for keeping watch of the temple by residing near it with a guard (parikalam).

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Seṅkunram † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the mandapa, same temple.
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Registers a gift of 400 kuli of land for a perpetual lamp to Sri [da]jauparu(a-Perumal) by one of the members of the assembly. Evidently this pillar must have been brought here from the neighbouring Perumal temple.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Seṅkunram † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone built into the floor of the shrine of the goddess in Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Seṅkunram † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone fixed in the prahara of Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register a gift of land for worship and for festival days.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kēvanur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone above the entrance into the central shrine of Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginning and end built in. States that the temple (P) is the gift of Vayiradigal alias Korranarpu.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xvi||329" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XVI, No. 329</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Pasumattur — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the Pasupatīsvara temple
cells.remarks: Beginning built in and stones missing. Seems to register a provision for night offerings and two lamps to the god.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Veppangeneri — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone in a field near the lake
cells.remarks: Registers an öripati-grani of 1,000 kuli by the assembly of Kavanur in Miyarv-nādu.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Mahadeva-malai — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south and west walls of the central shrine in the Mahadeva-swamin temple
cells.remarks: Registers that the Mahanayakacharya Bodi Kondama-Nayaka granted thervillage Kavanuppe in the Kati-asima to the god Mahadeva of the Mahadeva hill.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Mahadeva-malai † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone fixed in a water-channel at the southern extremity of Chendattur.
cells.remarks: Mentions the death of Mavali-Vanarayar alias Kudipari-malaipan, residing in Igalaimangalam in a cattle-raid at Chendattur.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xii|i|101" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XII Pt I, No. 101</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Mahadeva-malai † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another hero-stone in the place of Mahadeva-swamin. †
cells.remarks: Mentions that the brother-in-law of the individual men-tioned above-fall in the raid along with Ma[ka]tuan [Udai]ya[ma]llan.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Melmurungi — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the Activara temple
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Intercepted by pillars and the Dakshinamurti shrine. Registers a gift of 1,500 kuli of land as devadana, free of taxes, for worship and repairs to the image of Activara set up at Nallur by a private individual.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Melmurungi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero stone in a field a little north of the Railway station at Melpatti
cells.remarks: Records the fall of a chief of Vāṇaraiyar in a skirmish with Pūdi-Adigaiyar of Kāvanūr in Mī-Aru-nāḍu, a subdivision of Paḍuvūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Melmurungi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock (locally known as Emmankal) to the south of Rajakkal.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction 'Tirumagal-pōla etc.' Registers a gift of 600 kuḷi of land by the residents of Ējadalai in Kīḻaḍaiyāḷ-nāḍu in Perumbāppāḍi in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-maṇḍalam for offerings at the three services to the god Agastīśvara. Mentions the measuring rod 'Kaḍigaikaṭṭakkōl.' The total 600 kuḷi seems to be a mistake.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Melmurungi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the rock of Activara †
cells.remarks: End of examination of the previous inscription. Records a gift of 1,738 kuḷi of land free of tax for the conduct of the Śrībali ceremony in the temple of Mahādēva. Mentions the measuring rod 'Śīhabānu-paḍinā-jaṅkōl'.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Round the dhvajastambha platform of the Perumal temple
cells.remarks: Records that Ammuṇḍu-tayyar who held the Jaghir of Erikutti ordered the construction of 2 tanks and that made a gift of 600 kuḷi of land to certain officers. The construction of the tanks was left in the hands of Nimmala Ayyappa-Nāyaka and Pērumāl-Nāyaka. Mentions also that Sattal-laṅkan (Saḍat-ulla Khan) the Nabā of Karṇāṭaka was ruling under the overlordship of Farukān Bādshā (Faruk Shiyar), the grandson of Aurangazeb.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab in a field to the north of the same village (as Perumal temple). †
cells.remarks: States that Nimmala Ayyappa-Nāyaka of Erugurti constructed a tank and enumerates a number of dōyas as the beneficiaries (dēvadāya) of the land.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xii|i|127" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XII Pt I, No. 127</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock at the base of the Durga-hill at Alankuppam (near Pa-raṅkāl).
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of land as dēvadāna to the god Vighnēśvara on the Dēvaṇamalai hill by Śiṅgaṇa-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the top of the hill of Perumal †
cells.remarks: Evidently the century has been omitted in the date. States that in the time of Pañchava Brahma-mātāya, Bhuvana-giri the disciple of Sōbharaśadēva of Bāṅgēre constructed the Durga temple of Bhuvana-bhūjēśvara.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock to the south of Morijona near Rōgumpaṭṭai.
cells.remarks: Verse in praise of Pallava king Vīra-Nolamba-Vīru-Kāḍava-rāyar, son of Koḍai Alappirandār, who conquered Toṇḍai-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock near a deserted Īśvara temple to the south of Damal-cheruvu (near Pillakuppam)
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by Sēvandan, a sāmanta of (Vi)llaladēvan and two others to Vaḷaṅgai-vanda Nāyaṇār in Aḍigaikkāṇavūr alias Aṭṭimangalam alias Tamaraich-cheṅguṇi in the northern division of Jampu[ḍai]tu-nāḍu, a district of Paḍuvūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab in the tank-weir at Periya-Varikkam
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 500 kuḷi of land by the village assembly to the wife and children of a hero who fell in a cattle-raid in Varikkaiyam alias Chāmuṇḍīśvaramaṅgalam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab fixed in a field near the same weir, Īśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift for offerings and worship in a matha at Viriñchipuram.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab fixed at the left of entrance into the Madhava-Perumal temple at Tuttipat
cells.remarks: Records that Rājaśrī Jagadéva Rayayalu granted the village Tuttipat'tu to the god Madhivasaryasvami.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab at the right of the entrance, into Madhava-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Repeats the grant noted above.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of the central shrine of Madhava-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the image of Vennaikkadi in the temple of Madhava-Peruma[] by the headman of Śirupanpūr. Tuttipat[] is otherwise called Vijaya Narasimha-chaturvēdimaṅgam. Continuation of first line not traceable on the wall.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rook in a potter's house at Malayampattu
cells.remarks: Ends of lines covered by the roof of the house. Seems to record the settlement of a quarrel between the Idangai and Valangai sects in which there was loss of life on both sides.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone to the west of Chola Kumaramangalam
cells.remarks: Records the death of Manikulain, son of Aduppa, ........nagar [TIlakkamindan in a cattle-raid (garugarpra)] after re-covery at the cattle.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Erikutti † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone in a coconut garden to the north of Karumbur (Little).
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to refer to a gift of gold and paddy by a private individual for worship on the new and full moon days in the temple of Tirupparkathidėva at Tiruch-chendura-mangalam.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Tirumani — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the Chola deserted Perumal temple
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to be the king confirming the order of his son granting land for the formation of a village with suitable alterations for extending the lake on the northern side. The residents of Pājarāja-Vinayagar ordered this grant to be engraved on stone in the Perumal temple.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the Sanyasistone
cells.remarks: Much damaged. A few lines are built in at the bottom of the front side. Seems to register a gift of land for daily offerings to the god by the assembly of Kalañjar.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rook to the north of the same village (as Perumal temple). †
cells.remarks: Seems to refer to a gift of land.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the base of the deserted Peru-mal temple in the same village
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to refer to a sale of 780 kuli of land as cripaṭṭi by the assembly of . . . Mentions the measuring-rod 'Kadigaikalattukol', Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to the Śrīkoyil.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the base of the deserted Peru-mal temple in the same village (as Perumal temple) †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a gift of land to the Sri koyil.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the tank at Vijayanagara. Angarankuppam.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a sarvamānya gift of 200 kuli of land.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up to the west of the village, Senur
cells.remarks: Records that Pöttu-Nāyaka, an agent of Kalama-Naya-kanayyan gave for the merit of the latter the fish-lease money of the tank at Senalur to be spent on the tank itself. Achyutarāya is called Gandakatarī [Śa]ava. Senalūr was being governed by Kempadēvar Annagal, one of the subordinates of Achyutarāya but it was leased out to Velūr Kalama-[Nāya]lėkar Ayyay.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Kalang-jur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock at the base of the Ara-vath-hills to the west of the village Sathghar.
cells.remarks: Refers to some grant (not specified) made by Sovavam Thiruvengalappa-Nayaka to a cobbler (madiga) named Vankatadu.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock (locally known as Perumal-rock) to the east of the village Narlampet.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of 100 kunṭas of manya land made to the god Rāmabhadrasvāmi by Tumba Verhkaṭava.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Bairapalli — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the east wall (left of entrance) of the Bairappan temple
cells.remarks: The inscription is engraved below the figure of a horse led by a groom, preceded and followed by two attendants with swords in their hands. States that this stone was the gift of a certain Baiyapa-śetṭi, son of Chinna-Jōgi-Gauda.

cells.location: ANANTAPUR DISTRICT / GOOTY TALUK · Bairapalli † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock (locally known as Uppal-palli) in a reserve forest to the west of the same village (as Bairappan temple). †
cells.remarks: Refers to the donation of a trough made by a private individual.
